title.rendered: Best iPhone Xs Max Designer Cases in 2026

content.rendered:
The other day, I stumbled upon some of the best designer cases for iPhone Xs Max. And I was like, “They deserve a serious look sooner than later!” That’s when I thought of making a roundup of the most attractive looking cases for Apple’s all-new phablet.

Have a penchant for designer profiles? I’ve you covered by picking out the 10 most fascinating cases. Even though these cases are fully geared for raising fashion statement, they can provide a basic safeguard to your smartphone. So, the style won’t come at the cost of protection. Let’s check out the collection!

Table of Contents
  1. Case-Mate WATERFALL
  2. Speck Presidio Inked
  3. i-Blason Cosmo
  4. Sonix (Gummy Bear)
  5. Sonix (flower pattern)
  6. GVIEWIN
  7. Frepstudio
  8. Luxendary Chrome Series 2
  9. Caka
  10. Cutebe

1. Case-Mate WATERFALL

The stunning snow globe effect with the moving glitter helps WATERFALL steal the hearts in the very first glance.

However, what makes it stand out is the ability to withstand drops of up to 10 feet. That means you can continue to flaunt your style without endangering the protection of your smartphone.

Moreover, this enchanting case also plays nice with wireless charging and comes in multiple colors like gold, rose gold, purple and more.

USP: Gorgeous design
Check out on Amazon

2. Speck Presidio Inked

Featuring charming design, “Speck Presidio Inked” is one of the most attractive designer cases for iPhone Xs Max. The vivid flower pattern looks pretty nice on it.

To me, the best thing about this case is the ability to endure up to 10 feet drops. So, you shouldn’t worry about the protection of your smartphone as long as this cover is on.

The mix of rugged PC and rubber makes it extremely durable. And with the rubberized texture, the cover feels nice to the touch.

USP: Attractive flower pattern
Check out on Amazon

3. i-Blason Cosmo

It’s show off time! Flaunting a glittering design, “i-Blason Cosmo” has got the looks to arrest attention.

Thanks to the solid PC back panel and soft TPU bumper, it can fight out shock without much effort. The rubbery sides ensure there is less chance of drops.

The wireless charging support makes Cosmo a great asset for regular use. Plus, you can choose this nice-looking designer case in a couple of hues: pink and marble.

USP: Wireless charging support
Check out on i-Blason

4. Sonix (Gummy Bear)

This offering from “Sonix” looks a bit funky. It may not look as charming as its counterparts but it’s good enough to make a good-looking match with the Xs Max.

The rubberized cover feels grippy in the hands. And the pronounced buttons provide clicky responsive. The ability to offer trusted military-grade defense makes Sonix an easy pick. That’s not all, you can choose compact designer cover in several color variants.

USP: Military-grade protection
Check out on Amazon

5. Sonix (flower pattern)

One more nice-looking cover from Sonix. However, unlike its sibling, it comes in as many as 21 enchanting color variants. So, if you want to choose from a variety of attractive patterns, you should go for this one.

Regarding protection, this designer case can withstand accidental drops. The shock-absorbent rubber not just helps it endure impact but also offers enhanced grip. Moreover, Sonix comes with a limited lifetime warranty.

USP: Several fascinating color variants
Check out on Amazon

6. GVIEWIN

This designer case is my personal favorite. It features marble design on the back along with a glossy finish that makes it look real. Apart from design, the case also protects the iPhone XS Max from accidental falls and bumps along with protection from scratches. The bumpers on the frame add to the protection ability of the case.

Overall, the case is incredibly slim and sleek with precise cuts giving unhindered access to all ports and functions. Lastly, there are three designs available along with different colors.

USP: Glossy finish
Check out on Amazon

7. Frepstudio

If it’s time to make the iPhone Xs Max look pleasing to the eyes, you can’t go wrong with “Frepstudio.” Thanks to the floral pattern, the cover has a pretty design.

Despite looking quite slim, this designer case can absorb minor falls and also resist scrapes. The OLED screen remains protected from scratches due mainly to the elevated edge. All the cutouts seem to be on the point, while the buttons respond to the press smoothly. The high-quality TPU material means it won’t get yellow over time.

USP: Slim design
Check out on Amazon

8. Luxendary Chrome Series 2

“Super Unique” is the ideal word for Luxendary Chrome Series 2. The 3D printed design keeps its shine alive for long. The anti-yellowing coating further boosts the cover and also plays a vital role in offering improved hold.

As for protection, Chrome Series 2 can resist regular wear and tear. With the flexible snap-on structure, you can easily install and remove it.

Talking about the cutouts, they are exactly on point.

USP: 3D printed design
Check out on Amazon

9. Caka

The glittering profile for your Xs Max! “Caka” presents an extremely flexible designer case that wraps around the phablet immaculately.

The eye-catching bling adds more charm to the cover. With the soft TPU bumper, the sides have the comfy feel. The smooth buttons are easy to handle, the exact holes allow quick access to ports.

USP: Sparkling bling
Check out on Amazon

10. Cutebe

“Cutebe” features a bit simple design and offers a little freedom to your beast to showcase its elegance. The flower pattern looks nice on it, while the shock-absorbing TPU bumper offers it more stability.

The hardback panel can resist bumps and also stop scratches from damaging your smartphone. I find the buttons very responsive as they offer tactile feedback. Besides, the non-slip exterior also provides better hold, thereby cutting down the chance of accidental falls.

USP: Shock-absorbing design
Check out on Amazon

That’s all! Assuming you have found the above designer suits for Xs Max adorable.

Your pick?

With so many beautiful contenders at the disposal, choosing the most appealing case should have been an easier task for you. Do you want to include any of your favorite case in the above lineup? Feel free to let us know its name.

What type of designer cases do you like the most? Share your feedback in the comments.

Editorial Note: When you purchase through our links, we earn a small commission. However, this does not affect our opinions or evaluations. Learn more about our Editorial Process and Disclaimer.

title.rendered: Best Apple TV games in 2026

content.rendered:
One of the biggest advantages of owning an Apple TV is the larger screen for enjoying your favorite games. While playing games on the iPhone does have its charm, playing the latest games on a larger screen truly brings out the best of the games. Moreover, the best games for Apple TV come in different genres for everyone to enjoy.

Furthermore, while you can play a few web browser games on Apple TV, I’ve curated the list based purely on games available on the official App Store. Without further ado, let’s dive into the list!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Evoland 2 – Editor's choice
  • 2. Crossy Road – For wholesome family fun
  • 3. PAC-MAN 256 – Takes you back to the 1980s
  • 4. Just Dance Now – For all the social people
  • 5. Alto's Adventure – Takes you to zen mode
  • 6. Riptide GP: Renegade – A unique take on racing games
  • 7. Spaceteam – Hilarious co-op game
  • 8. Playdead's INSIDE – For an indie adventure

1. Evoland 2 – Editor’s choice

Evoland 2 is a gamer’s paradise – there’s no question about it. Think of it as a tribute to all the classic games you’ve played before. In fact, there are so many parts to explore about the game that you’re sure to take over 20 hours to complete the game in its entirety.

Evoland 2 attempts to take you on a journey through the land of gaming. The way the game pays homage to the games that came before it is truly unique. Some levels are shooter-based. Other levels can turn into a 2D RPG with side-scrolling adventures.

Moreover, since the game was released on the PC first, this PC port takes total advantage of the larger screen that you get when using Apple TV. This is one of the best Apple TV games.

Unfortunately, the control scheme of the game isn’t very friendly to beginners.

Price: $4.99

Download

2. Crossy Road – For wholesome family fun

I’m sure you’ve either heard of or played Crossy Road earlier. This game is one of the best casual and family-friendly games out there. In addition, it’s also one of the best Apple TV games.

The larger screen on the Apple TV also makes the game feel bigger in size and perspective. You can now see more of the in-game screen and have a better view of the oncoming cars. That doesn’t mean that your job of crossing the road gets any easier though.

Keep progressing through the game to unlock more difficult challenges and unique characters. It’s an absurd world in Crossy Road, and you’re going to love it!

However, the game’s pace in the later stages can be quite difficult.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.99)

Download

3. PAC-MAN 256 – Takes you back to the 1980s

We all know how influential PAC-MAN has been in the world of gaming. It was and still is the quintessential arcade game for plenty of gamers. With PAC-MAN 256, you get an endless arcade game that caters to the whims of the modern era.

This time, things are slightly different. PAC-MAN has over 15 different powers that you can gain and use against the pesky Ghosts. Moreover, if you can attain a combo of 256 in-game, you’re going to receive a special prize.

On a side note, you know that a game is going to be good if it’s been developed by the creators of the amazing Crossy Road!

The grinding mechanics in the game for attaining rewards needs to be reworked, however. It takes far too long to receive an appropriate number of coins.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $0.99)

Download

4. Just Dance Now – For all the social people

If you’re at a party and want to grab everyone’s attention, what better way than to start dancing and moving to the beats? With Just Dance Now, you can turn the groove and the beats into a game where everyone can join in.

The game features over 500 songs and choreographies for you to go through. This includes classics like 24K Magic by Bruno Mars and Bad Liar by Selena Gomez, among others. The best part? There’s no limit to the number of people who can join in. Whether it’s 10 people or 100, everyone can join. Finally, if you need your dance playlist to make a mark, you can create that too!

Unfortunately, the coin system in the game is quite flawed and complex for a game of this nature.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $2.99)

Download

5. Alto’s Adventure – Takes you to zen mode

There are very few visually appealing games that combine all of their elements and take you on a relaxing journey. Alto’s Adventure is one of them.

The game has a beautiful, minimalist aesthetic that will win you over instantly. Moreover, the game is classified as a sports and adventure game. While it incorporates both sides seamlessly, the gameplay will almost behave as a reward after a hard day’s work.

The game can be deceptively difficult at times. However, your snowboarding journey across hundreds of mountains will be filled with intrigue and relaxation.

Some people have complained about the wingsuit mechanics of the game, though.

Price: $4.99

Download

6. Riptide GP: Renegade – A unique take on racing games

With Riptide GP: Renegade, all your previous notions on racing games are thrown out the window! Racing games are usually of two types. Firstly, you get the arcade racing games that don’t care much for simulation elements. Secondly, there are simulation racing games whose charm lies in the depth of gameplay.

This game features hydrojet racing, where you and your friends battle it out on watery tracks, jumping over waterfalls and performing stunts. It has a good story too, with your character vying for redemption as they’re kicked out of the Riptide GP League.

It has some serious levels of customizations for both player and the hydrojet, allowing you to put your spin on the game. Moreover, the online component of the game is also worth a try.

The game’s graphics look a bit dated by today’s standards.

Price: $2.99

Download

7. Spaceteam – Hilarious co-op game

If you’re looking for Apple TV multiplayer games, I doubt that it’ll get any better than Spaceteam. This isn’t your usual co-op game.

Firstly, most of the commands in the game are satirical and sound absurd. Secondly, when your panel is filled with random buttons, and you have to coordinate with your friends to push the buttons at the right time, you’ll realize how random the situation can be!

Moreover, the instructions are time-sensitive. This adds a level of challenge to the game as well. The only issue with the game is that it tends to crash.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $2.99)

Download

8. Playdead’s INSIDE – For an indie adventure

If you haven’t played INSIDE yet, you should get on it right away. This game is a beautiful, haunting journey into the depths of human consciousness and society.

The game combines elements of puzzles with platforming into an aesthetic that will catch you off guard. Regardless, you’ll get hooked on it almost instantaneously. There are plenty of metaphors to decipher in this game, from that of human nature to the socioeconomic status prevalent today.

If you want a game that will hook you in with its premise and keep your interest through puzzles, metaphors, and analogies, try INSIDE.

Unfortunately, the game’s campaign is quite short. Many players, myself included, would’ve liked a longer solo campaign.

Price: Free (In-app purchases start at $6.99)

Download

Wrapping it up!

With Apple TV presenting greater gaming opportunities through Apple Arcade, I’m pretty sure there are better games on their way for consumers. So, what did you think of my list of the best Apple TV games? Have you tried any of these games for yourself? If yes, which one did you try, and what did you like/dislike about it?

mainEntity.name: How much does AppleCare+ cost?

title.rendered: Can’t delete apps on iPhone or iPad? 5 ways to fix it

content.rendered:
It’s usually pretty straightforward to delete apps on your iPhone or iPad. However, sometimes, you might run into some unexpected issues and find that the Delete App option is missing or grayed out. In this article, I’ve covered several easy troubleshooting steps to help you fix the “Can’t delete apps on iPhone” issue.

Table of Contents
  • Why can't I delete an app on my iPhone?
  • How to fix can't delete apps on iPhone
    • Restart your iPhone
    • Disable Restrictions on iPhone
    • Delete waiting apps from iPhone
    • Delete apps from Settings
    • Reset All Settings

Why can’t I delete an app on my iPhone?

If you can’t delete apps on your iPhone, it may be due to a few common reasons.

  • Non-removable apps: You can delete almost all third-party apps and several inbuilt Apple apps. However, you can’t remove core system iOS apps like
    • Phone
    • Messages
    • Settings
    • Photos
    • Camera
    • Safari
    • App Store
    • Clock
    • Find My
    • Health
    • Wallet
  • Screen time restrictions: Have your parents put a Screen Time lock on apps, or have you mistakenly done the same to yourself?
  • Mobile Device Management (MDM)restrictions: If your employer, school, or other organization gives you an iPhone, it might have a particular profile that prevents the uninstallation of certain apps. Contact the relevant admin for assistance.

    If this is the scenario, you can’t delete the apps unless you have administrator rights. So, hide the app and make peace with it.
  • Incomplete download: The app download is frozen due to an error, and now it’s neither on nor off your iPhone.

How to fix can’t delete apps on iPhone

Follow these troubleshooting methods to fix the app deletion issue.

1. Restart your iPhone

This is an almost sure-shot solution to address this issue successfully. When you cannot remove apps, restart the iPhone.

  • To restart your iPhone: Press and hold down the Power and Volume buttons until a slider appears on the screen. Drag the slider to turn off the device. Wait a few moments for the iPhone to turn off completely and the screen to go black. Press and hold the Power button until the Apple logo appears.

After a minute, switch on the iPhone and try to delete the app. You should have no trouble performing this action.

2. Disable Restrictions on iPhone

Screen Time restrictions can prevent you from deleting apps. If you don’t see the Delete App option or it is greyed out, it’s possible you have Content & Privacy Restrictions applied.

  1. Open the Settings app and tap on Screen Time.
  2. Tap on Content & Privacy Restrictions. If you see “Turn On Screen Time,” that means this feature isn’t active. Skip the steps below and move to the next solution.

  3. Tap on iTunes & App Store Purchases. Enter the Screen Time passcode when asked.
  4. Tap on Deleting Apps and choose Allow.

Now, go back to the iPhone Home screen and try to delete the app. There should be no problem now.

3. Delete waiting apps from iPhone

Waiting apps, a.k.a. app’s stuck with the text ‘Waiting…’ below the grayed application icon. To fix this, i.e., let the app download, ensure your iPhone has enough free space and is connected to strong Wi-Fi or cellular data.

Once the installation is complete, you can remove the app normally. To terminate this pending app installation and delete the app, long-press the app icon and choose Cancel Download from the popup.

If you do not see this option, keep pressing the app icon until jiggle mode is active. Tap on the waiting app’s minus icon (if you see it) and then Delete App → Delete.

4. Delete apps from Settings

Sometimes, the iPhone Home Screen may face issues that prevent you from deleting apps. Moreover, some apps don’t appear on the App Library or Home Screen. In such cases, you can try uninstalling apps from Settings.

  1. Go to the Settings app on your iPhone.
  2. Select General and tap on iPhone Storage.

  3. Scroll down to find the app list. Select the app you want to remove.
  4. Tap the Delete App option and select Delete when the prompt comes up.

5. Reset All Settings

Well, we are on the last resort; if nothing helps, reset all settings from the Settings app → General → Transfer or Reset iPhone. Now, select Reset and tap Reset All Settings. Once the process is complete, try to uninstall the app.

However, this trick will also wipe all your saved Wi-Fi networks, preferences, and passwords. So, make sure you note that before proceeding.

Signing off

Not being able to delete apps on your iPhone can be frustrating, but with the right steps, you can quickly resolve the issue. I hope these hacks helped you delete apps from your iPhone. If not, please feel free to connect with us in the comment section below.

Want more assistance? Check out these articles

  • How to restore deleted apps on iPhone or iPad
  • How to close apps on iPhone and iPad for smooth performance
  • How to unhide apps in iOS 18 on iPhone

acceptedAnswer.text: While the Sensitive Content Warning feature aims to warn users before accessing sensitive or explicit content, it may not block all instances of such content. Its effectiveness depends on the accuracy of the content classification system.

mainEntity.name: Can you insure an iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, there are a number of ways to insure your iPhone. However, most people prefer buying directly from AppleCare.

mainEntity.name: Who should get iPhone insurance?

acceptedAnswer.text: iPhone insurance is essential for those who are accident-prone or tend to lose their phones easily. It’s a wise option if you intend to keep your iPhone for more than a year.

mainEntity.name: How much does AppleCare+ cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: This depends on your device. If you have newer devices namely iPhone X or later, the protection plan starts from $10 monthly or $200 yearly. It is lower for older devices.

mainEntity.name: How can I buy AppleCare+ for products I didn’t buy directly from Apple?

acceptedAnswer.text: It’s easy to opt for AppleCare+ anytime up to 60 days after purchasing your iPhone. You can get it online by going to Apple’s Service and Support page. Enter your device’s serial number to be guided through the process of purchasing a plan. You will have to run a diagnostic test on your device to ensure that you’re not trying to buy a plan for a device that’s already damaged.

mainEntity.name: Can I cancel an iPhone insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can usually cancel a plan within a limited period after buying it. For instance, if you cancel Apple Care+ within 30 days of purchasing it, you will get a full refund less any service you received. Call Apple on 1–800-MY-APPLE for more details.

mainEntity.name: Can you set your iPhone to turn it off after a certain time?

acceptedAnswer.text: iOS 18 doesn't offer any feature to shut down your iPhone after a certain time. However, you can configure to lock your device after a certain period from Settings > Display & Brightness > Auto-Lock.

mainEntity.name: Do all iPhones have the auto-start feature?

acceptedAnswer.text: All iPhones updated to iOS 18 and above can restart automatically after three days of inactivity. However, in some cases, your iPhone may reboot due to a software bug or a glitch.

mainEntity.name: Can you turn off Inactivity Reboot on iOS 18?

acceptedAnswer.text: Currently, you can't disable the Inactivity Reboot feature on iOS 18, as it's built into the system's code. Apple is working on refining Inactivity Reboot for iOS 18.2, but it's unlikely that a toggle to turn it off will be included.

title.rendered: How to hide the MacBook Pro notch

content.rendered:
The latest models of MacBook Pro and Air feature a notch at the top, highlighting the front camera. However, while functional, the design isn’t everyone’s favorite. If you, too, find the MacBook notch obstructive or just want a distraction-free, cleaner display view, there are multiple ways to hide it. In this guide, I will show you how to make the notch disappear on your MacBook.

How to hide the notch on MacBook Pro

There are multiple ways to hide the notch from your MacBook Pro. Let me show you!

    1. Go fullscreen mode

    The quickest and simplest way to hide the notch is to open the app in fullscreen. This setting automatically turns the menu bar black, hiding all its contents, including the notch. Since most native and third-party apps support fullscreen mode, it is pretty universal as well.

    To enable fullscreen mode on any app, click the green round (fullscreen) button at the top left of the window. You can also use a keyboard shortcut to engage the fullscreen mode: press Control + Command + F.

    If you need to access something from the menu bar, hover the cursor over the area. The menu items will reappear, and you can select the one you need. When you are ready to exit the fullscreen mode, click the green or red button or press Control + Command + F.

    Special tip: The notch also magically vanishes when you invoke split view in Mac. So, multitask your way into notch-less-ness.

    2. Scale app menu bars

    While hiding the menu bar works for most apps, it fails for apps that extensively use items from the menu bar. In some scenarios, the camera notch conceals menu options, which can be quite disturbing.

    Luckily, Apple has realized the issue and incorporated a neat feature that automatically scales the app’s menu bar area to fit under the notch area.

    1. Launch the Application folder.
    2. Right-click the app you want.
    3. Select Get Info from the contextual menu.
    4. Under the General section, check the box next to Scale to fit below the built-in camera.

    Close this window and restart the app; it will auto-adjust according to the notch area. Notably, this doesn’t apply across the system; you’ll have to enable the settings individually for each app.

    3. Use third-party apps 

    A great thing with trouble in Apple’s paradise is that there can be an app for it. And luckily, for all the notch-haters, there are indeed some great apps.

    I. TopNotch

    A simple app that promises to make the MacBook Pro notch disappear like a ninja. It boasts a toggle that turns the menu bar black when enabled and efficiently hides the notch.

    It can modify both static and dynamic macOS wallpapers and keep the notch under wraps for as long as you want. Additionally, it supports multiple displays and allows you to add rounded corners to your wallpapers to match the rounded corners of the MacBook Pro.

    Price: Free

    Download

    II. Forehead

    Indie developer Jordi Bruin loves the new notch. However, he knows not many will accept the change as easily. So, he converted it into an earning opportunity and developed Forehead. The app modifies your current wallpaper to add a black backing, which hides the notch.

    Interestingly, it takes the concept of the rounded edge to another level with up to 100 corner radius, an option to start rounding corners below the bar or round just the top or bottom corners.

    Though it doesn’t support dynamic wallpapers yet, the developer might release that in later updates.

    Price: Free

    Download

    III. De-Notch-ifier

    While you are at it, why shouldn’t you have more fun with the menu bar? De-Notch-ifier can easily de-notch your MacBook Pro with one tap. It could also help bring more colors to the menu bar, 50 shades of red, orange, green, or grey.

    What’s more? You can even set different menu bar colors for Light and Dark modes and decide how rounded you want the corners. Plus, you get a 14-day trial, so you can test it to your heart’s content before putting down that dollar.

    Price: $9.95

    Download

    Bye, Bye notch

    In all honesty, I think we all should give the notch a chance. After all, the iPhone 13 still has a notch (albeit smaller than before). So, we can safely assume the MacBook Pro notch is here to stay, and we better start embracing it.

    The good thing is, we can hide it whenever we want!

    For more amazing Mac hacks, check out the listings below.

    • How to use Universal Clipboard on your Mac, iPhone, and iPad
    • How to fix a Mac that keeps restarting

acceptedAnswer.text: iPhone insurance is essential for those who are accident-prone or tend to lose their phones easily. It’s a wise option if you intend to keep your iPhone for more than a year.

mainEntity.name: How much does AppleCare+ cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: This depends on your device. If you have newer devices namely iPhone X or later, the protection plan starts from $10 monthly or $200 yearly. It is lower for older devices.

mainEntity.name: How can I buy AppleCare+ for products I didn’t buy directly from Apple?

acceptedAnswer.text: It’s easy to opt for AppleCare+ anytime up to 60 days after purchasing your iPhone. You can get it online by going to Apple’s Service and Support page. Enter your device’s serial number to be guided through the process of purchasing a plan. You will have to run a diagnostic test on your device to ensure that you’re not trying to buy a plan for a device that’s already damaged.

mainEntity.name: Can I cancel an iPhone insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can usually cancel a plan within a limited period after buying it. For instance, if you cancel Apple Care+ within 30 days of purchasing it, you will get a full refund less any service you received. Call Apple on 1–800-MY-APPLE for more details.

mainEntity.name: Can you set your iPhone to turn it off after a certain time?

acceptedAnswer.text: iOS 18 doesn't offer any feature to shut down your iPhone after a certain time. However, you can configure to lock your device after a certain period from Settings > Display & Brightness > Auto-Lock.

mainEntity.name: Do all iPhones have the auto-start feature?

acceptedAnswer.text: All iPhones updated to iOS 18 and above can restart automatically after three days of inactivity. However, in some cases, your iPhone may reboot due to a software bug or a glitch.

mainEntity.name: Can you turn off Inactivity Reboot on iOS 18?

acceptedAnswer.text: Currently, you can't disable the Inactivity Reboot feature on iOS 18, as it's built into the system's code. Apple is working on refining Inactivity Reboot for iOS 18.2, but it's unlikely that a toggle to turn it off will be included.

title.rendered: How to recover deleted photos on Mac (5 Proven ways)

content.rendered:
Have you lost or accidentally deleted photos on your Mac? Photos are memories you want to cherish for a lifetime, but since they’re stored on hard drives, volumes, or other drives, they are always susceptible to loss. Although Mac offers Photos apps and backup services to help manage and protect image files, technical malfunctions can still occur. Accidental deletion, formatting, corruption, malware, a faulty macOS upgrade, or even a virus attack can lead to the loss of your photos.

To help, we’ve compiled five proven methods for recovering deleted photos on your Mac in any data loss situation. Let’s go through each method carefully.

Table of Contents
  • Method 1: Recover deleted photos using the Recently Deleted Folder
  • Method 2: Recover deleted photos from Mac Trash
  • Method 3: Restore lost photos from iCloud
  • Method 4: Recover deleted photos from a Mac local backup
  • Method 5: Recover permanently deleted photos with Data Recovery Software

Method 1: Recover deleted photos using the Recently Deleted Folder

The Photos app on macOS ensures that you do not delete your pictures in one go. Its ‘Recently Deleted’ folder keeps the deleted pictures for 30 days. So once you delete the images and later realize you need to keep them, restore them from this folder in the Photos app. 

Here’s how to restore photos from the ‘Recently Deleted’ folder:

  1. Open the Photos app.
  2. In the left pane, click Recently Deleted.
  3. Select the images you wish to restore and click Recover at the top.

Method 2: Recover deleted photos from Mac Trash

If you can’t find the deleted photos in the ‘Recently Deleted’ folder, look for them in macOS’s Trash bin. The trash bin keeps the deleted data for 30 days or until you empty it yourself.

Here’s how to restore photos from Trash:

  1. Open Trash.
  2. Find and right-click the required photo.
  3. Select ‘Put Back.’

Now, you will see the restored photos in the original folder.

Method 3: Restore lost photos from iCloud

If you are using iCloud for Mac backup, you can recover the lost photos from here. Like the Photos app, iCloud also has a ‘Recently Deleted’ folder that keeps the images for 30 days. After this period, iCloud will automatically delete the pictures forever.

Steps to recover lost photos from iCloud:

  1. Go to icloud.com and sign in to your account using Apple ID.
  2. Go to Photos.
  3. Navigate to the Recently Deleted album.
  4. Select the desired photos and click Recover.

Method 4: Recover deleted photos from a Mac local backup

A backup is a great help when you have lost your photos or other data. You can easily retrieve deleted or missing photos from there. Check for the lost pictures in your macOS backup drives, Time Machine, or other external storage that you may be using.

Steps to retrieve photos from Time Machine:

  1. Connect the external drive with Time Machine backup to the Mac.
  2. Open a Finder window and click the location from where the photos were deleted.
  3. Click to open the Time Machine icon in the menu.
    You will see your available backups.
  4. Click the latest or the required backup date.
  5. Go to your photo library backup, select, and click Restore.

Depending on the size of the files, it may take a while to restore your photos. All photos are recovered at their original location.

Method 5: Recover permanently deleted photos with Data Recovery Software

Unfortunately, if you can’t find your deleted photos in the Photos app’s backup, Trash, or ‘Recently Deleted’ folder or iCloud, you must utilize photo recovery software. 

An advanced photo recovery tool for macOS, like the Stellar Photo Recovery Premium version, can rescue you from different photo loss situations. Whether you have formatted the macOS drive/removable media, emptied Trash, or missing photos due to unclear reasons, the software recovers in all critical cases.

You can retrieve lost photos of almost any file type, including RAW, JPEG, TIFF, PNG, DNG, NEF, SR2, and photos shot with Sony, Canon, Fujifilm, Nikon, Olympus, and other cameras.

Additionally, Stellar Photo Recovery Premium can repair corrupt photos and videos that are distorted or do not open.

Key benefits of recovery software

  • Recover photos, videos, and music.
  • Restores deleted photos with original date-timestamp and name.
  • Retrieves camera RAW files.
  • Repairs corrupt or damaged photos and videos.

Steps to recover photos using Mac photo recovery software 

  1. Download Stellar Photo Recovery Premium on Mac.

  2. Select Photos in the Select What to Recover screen.

  3. Select the location from which the photos are deleted.

  4. Click Scan and preview the found photos.
  5. Select the ones you want to restore and click Recover.

Signing off

Losing valuable photos is upsetting, and being unable to recover them is even more frustrating. However, acting quickly helps! I hope this guide helped you understand how to recover deleted photos on a Mac.

Using the tool is the most efficient way to restore the data. However, it’s always best to first use the free trial version of the software, which shows a preview of recoverable photos. Once you are assured of its effectiveness, make a buying decision.

  • How to reset network settings on Mac

acceptedAnswer.text: iPhone insurance is essential for those who are accident-prone or tend to lose their phones easily. It’s a wise option if you intend to keep your iPhone for more than a year.

mainEntity.name: How much does AppleCare+ cost?

title.rendered: Best camera lens protectors for iPhone 15 and 15 Plus in 2026

content.rendered:
In the iPhone 15 and 15 Plus, Apple upgraded the camera system and added bigger sensors. Thus, you must shield the larger camera bump with a lens protector. This prevents scratches, mess, and accidents from damaging the camera. As a result, your pictures and videos stay clear. Here, I’ve listed the best lens protectors for the iPhone 15 and 15 Plus.

Table of Content
  • ESR camera lens protectors – Editor's choice
  • Spigen GlasTR Optik camera lens protector
  • amFilm OneTouch bubble free camera cover
  • QsmQam protector anti-scratch camera cover
  • CAMTOVGCA 2 Pack Camera Lens Protector
  • ZXZone sapphire camera glass protector
  • Goton glitter diamond cover – Luxurious
  • UniqueMe scratch-resistant – Night shooting mode

1. ESR camera lens protectors – Editor’s choice

When it comes to safeguarding your iPhone 15 or 15 Plus camera lenses, the ESR camera lens protector stands out as the top choice. Crafted from high-quality, ultra-tempered glass boasting an impressive 110 lb impact resistance, it ensures the harshest bumps and scrapes won’t compromise your precious lenses.

What sets these protectors apart is their unwavering commitment to preserving photo quality. The ultra-high transparency level maintains the original image quality, while the individual-lens design leaves your flash uncovered and fully functional.

With the added convenience of an alignment guide, cleaning kit, and removal tool included in the package, the camera lens protecting brand makes it effortless to achieve crystal-clear photos, time and time again.

Pros

  • Military-grade-certified
  • Ultra-thin and clear design
  • Doesn’t affect the quality of photos or videos

Cons

  • Can be difficult to align perfectly

Check out on Amazon

2. Spigen GlasTR Optik camera lens protector

Having the Spigen lens protector is like giving your iPhone 15’s camera a suit of armor without adding any unnecessary bulk. With a snug and desired fit, Spigen ensures no extra interference with your camera’s performance. Additionally, your lens will remain streak-free with its anti-fingerprint coating.

So, you can consistently take beautiful pictures. Besides, these lens covers include top-quality tempered glass for the best possible scratch protection. The ideal fit guarantees that there won’t be an ugly rise, enabling you to concentrate on getting the perfect photo.

Pros

  • Protects camera lenses from scratches, cracks, and other damage
  • Easy to install and remove
  • Value for money

Cons

  • Can cause glare in bright sunlight

Check out on Amazon

3. amFilm OneTouch bubble free camera cover

If you want to keep your iPhone 15 or iPhone 15 Plus camera safe, amFilm lens protector is a top choice. It is simple to put on and like a plastic frame that fits perfectly on your iPhone.

You can set it up in just 30 seconds. All you have to do is place the frame, swipe the center, and you’re done. Plus, it comes with two sets, and you get an alignment tool and a super thin 0.33mm glass screen protector in the package. Easy and protective!

Pros

  • Precise fit
  • Case friendly
  • Screen protector bundle

Cons

  • Removing the protector is tricky

Check out on Amazon

4. QsmQam protector anti-scratch camera cover

The QsmQam camera lens covers are specifically designed to fit the iPhone 15 and 15 Plus, assuring a secure fit without hampering the device’s svelte appearance. You can take breathtaking pictures day or night as it includes a built-in night light ring that doesn’t interfere with flash shooting.

Additionally, these protectors are made of 9H tempered glass. So they protect against shocks, scratches, and friction. In addition, the 2.5D rounded corners guard against inadvertent finger contact. Thus, the lenses are 360° protected from water, dust, and fog.

Pros

  • Full coverage protection
  • Snug-Fit
  • 9H hardness

Cons

  • No variants available

Check out on Amazon

5. CAMTOVGCA 2 Pack Camera Lens Protector

Your priceless iPhone 15 and 15 Plus camera lens will be completely covered from potential damage and scratches by CAMTOVGCA’s seamless lens protection. It resists impacts and fingerprints because the protector is made of ultra-HD 9H tempered glass.

However, the remarkable light transmittance of these shields is what makes them stand out. Besides, you can take beautiful pictures and videos with flash in the darkest of nights with this lens protector, thanks to its specialized night anti-glare coating and AR anti-reflective capabilities.

Pros

  • Adheres securely
  • Fingerprint and scratch-resistant
  • Case friendly

Cons

  • Can be a bit tricky to remove without leaving residue

Check out on Amazon

6. ZXZone sapphire camera glass protector

The electroplating AF oiled technique used in ZXZone camera lens shields improves the protection’s texture while preserving the device’s natural color. It also has a nano inside glue that has outstanding stickiness and ensures that it remains put. So, put an end to your concerns about dents, dust, and falls.

The lens protector excels when it comes to protecting the sharpness of your photographs since it is made of high-transmittance sapphire material and has AR anti-reflection technology, which permanently eliminates camera glare. Additionally, its aluminum alloy and 5-layers unique design ensures long-lasting defense against scuffs, knocks, and dust.

Pros

  • Full lens coverage
  • Case-friendly design
  • Affordable price

Cons

  • Might feel bulky

Check out on Amazon

7. Goton glitter diamond cover – Luxurious

Are you looking for a camera lens cover that complements your iPhone 15 or 15 Plus flawlessly while providing excellent protection? The Goton camera lens shield is the solution. With its powerful adhesive qualities, this ultra-thin and lightweight cover protects your priceless camera lens from daily wear and tear, such as scratches, bumps, and drops.

Additionally, the built-in 9H tempered glass lens screen protector and high titanium alloy construction guarantee sturdy protection while blending in well with the original layout of your phone’s lens region. The protector’s surface is coated to guard against grease, perspiration, and fingerprint stains.

The iPhone 15 Plus camera lens protector case has rhinestones that shine brilliantly in the light. It also gives your phone a diamond-like appearance. You can choose from a variety of colors to complement your phone’s lens. Make sure the color matches your phone or contrasts.

Pros

  • 360° protection
  • Military-grade 9H tempered glass
  • Ultra-clear with no image distortion

Cons

  • Diamonds may fall out

Check out on Amazon

8. UniqueMe scratch-resistant – Night shooting mode

The UniqueMe camera lens protector snugly fits with your iPhone 15 and won’t readily budge while offering full coverage protection against drops, scratches, and other unexpected catastrophes. All of this is possible due to the upgraded electroplated sapphire AF film integrated into the 9H tempered glass.

This protector’s night flash circle, which won’t obstruct your nighttime photography and improves light transmission for crystal-clear pictures day or night, is what makes it unique. With the supplied frame, attaching this lens cover is a breeze, while adhesive has 10x durable protection. Furthermore, it guarantees a bubble-free experience.

Pros

  • Nano electrostatic automatic adsorption technology
  • 9H tempered glass
  • Does not affect flash or photo quality

Cons

  • It is more expensive than most camera lens protectors on the list

Check out on Amazon
 
Safety meets clarity!

The lens covers mentioned above will provide your device’s camera with the protection it needs, just like the cases for the iPhone 15 and 15 Plus do. They do a great job of keeping your camera scratch-free. So, you can improve your photography and video skills without worrying about damaging your iPhone’s camera.

So, which one are you going to pick? Let me know in the comments below.

  • Best iPhone 15 thin cases
  • Best iPhone 15 MagSafe cases
  • Best iPhone 15 series cable, cases and accessories

mainEntity.name: Do all iPhones have the auto-start feature?

acceptedAnswer.text: All iPhones updated to iOS 18 and above can restart automatically after three days of inactivity. However, in some cases, your iPhone may reboot due to a software bug or a glitch.

mainEntity.name: Can you turn off Inactivity Reboot on iOS 18?

acceptedAnswer.text: Currently, you can't disable the Inactivity Reboot feature on iOS 18, as it's built into the system's code. Apple is working on refining Inactivity Reboot for iOS 18.2, but it's unlikely that a toggle to turn it off will be included.

title.rendered: Best screen protectors for iPhone 14 and 14 Pro in 2026

content.rendered:
A nightmare situation: you dropped your new iPhone, then it got a scratch or a small crack on its original display. Nobody wants that, right? So, I have curated a list of the best screen protectors for iPhone 14 and 14 Pro. They offer the highest quality glass, so you will not face any clarity issues.

Table of Contents
  1. Spigen Tempered Glass screen protector – Editor's choice
  2. ESR Armorite – A strong screen protector
  3. JETech Full coverage screen protector – Value for money
  4. Torras Diamond Shield screen protector – Military-grade protection
  5. amFilm glass screen protector – One-touch application
  6. Ailun screen protectors – Combo pack
  7. Encased MagGlass – Protection for eyes

1. Spigen Tempered Glass screen protector – Editor’s choice

Spigen has been a market leader in accessories for ages. It’s always been the go-to choice for us. This particular tempered glass stands apart because of its unique design that protects the sensors. Its 9H hardness, oleophobic coating, and extreme clarity make it worth grabbing instantly.

It also comes with an installation kit that makes it easy to install and an effortless application. And it also comes in 2-in-one boxes, making it affordable.

Pros

  • Comes with an installation kit
  • Best all-rounder

Cons

  • Sometimes small bubbles appear after a week or two

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 | iPhone 14 Pro

2. ESR Armorite – A strong screen protector


This scratch-resistant screen protector for iPhone 14 and iPhone 14 Pro is one of the strongest screen protectors in this space. This ultimate screen protector can take up to 110 lb of impact on itself, which makes it a strong contender (literally).

ESR screen protector includes a Smooth and Clean fingerprint-resistant coating and powerful scratch defense to keep your screen crystal clear. This glass protector comes with a dust-repellent adhesive, alignment frame, and included cleaning kit to ensure a dust-free clean installation on your clean new device.

Pros

  • Rugged screen protector
  • Best quality at the price

Cons

  • Does not come with an installation kit
  • Causes bubbles during installation

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 | iPhone 14 Pro

3. JETech Full coverage screen protector – Value for money


JETech has one of the best full-screen protectors out in the market that covers the maximum of your screen real estate. It covers your front camera and Face ID sensor and provides a precise speaker cutout to ensure maximum clarity in the speaker.

With high light transmittance, the screen protector keeps the next to the original quality of photos and videos taken from the front camera. Also, JETech ensures enjoyable viewing and responsive touching experiences by using your bare screen with its screen protectors.

JETech ensures a precise fit for your iPhone 14 and iPhone 14 Pro to ensure you won’t even have a problem using the case. It also features an oleophobic coating for a smudge-free scrolling experience.

Pros

  • Edge-to-edge coverage
  • Case friendly

Cons

  • Lack of installation kit

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 | iPhone 14 Pro

4. Torras Diamond Shield screen protector – Military-grade protection


The toughest screen protector from Torras. It protects your iPhone like a diamond shield. They use Lithium Aluminosilicate tempered glass (generally used in military protection). It prevents daily bumps, scratches, and unexpected drops.

TORRAS claims that it can protect your iPhone from a drop of 6Ft. This glass screen protector also claims to highly touch sensitive this might be the selection for gamers. It also supports Face ID. Also, it is case friendly, which means you have the freedom to use any case with it.

Pros

  • Strong military-grade protection
  • Multiple quality tested
  • Climate-friendly pledge

Cons

  • Covers phone speaker
  • Some cuts are not precise

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 Pro

5. amFilm glass screen protector – One-touch application

When it comes to installation, this is the best choice. It gets applied in 60 seconds with patented auto alignment. The screen is framed in plastic that fits perfectly. The brand has patented this tech to stand out from the crowd. This screen protector only takes two steps. Just set it on your screen and swipe down from the middle.

This screen protector comes in a pack of two protectors and also has an installation kit.

Pros

  • Easy to imply
  • Comes with two

Cons

  • Ultra-thin might be fragile

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 | iPhone 14 Pro

6. Ailun screen protectors – Combo pack

These Alium screen protectors are built for your iPhone with precise measures and cuts. Just for under $10, it provides a pack of 3 screen protectors bundled with 3 camera lens protectors. For precise measures, it’s designed with precise laser cut technology.

The glass is ultra-thin and covered with 99.99% high-definition hydrophobic and oleophobic screen coatings that protect against sweat, oil smudges, and residue from fingerprints.

Pros

  • Value for money
  • Comes with a Camera lens protector

Cons

  • Chips out in some cases
  • Sometimes comes with less quantity

Check out on Amazon: iPhone 14 | iPhone 14 Pro

7. Encased MagGlass – Protection for eyes

The MagGlass is there especially crafted for iPhone. It was built keeping the protection of the eye in mind. Say, keeping an eye on eye protection was their motto. They have crafted a glass that promotes blue light filtering, resulting in eye comfort.

The Encased screen protector bundles with a tempered glass screen guard, cleaning cloth, dust remover, alcohol pad, and an alignment applicator – everything needed for a perfect, bubble-free installation.

Pros

  • Protects eyes
  • Blocks blue light

Cons

  • A bit uncomfortable
  • Visibility issues at a certain angle


Check out on encased: iPhone 14 | iPhone 14 Pro


Conclusion

Screen protectors have become an essential accessory for iPhones as they are affordable and provide good protection. I suggest combining a clear case with a screen protector to get full-body coverage. Let me know your preference in the comments below.

Read more:

  • Best accessories for iPhone 14 series

mainEntity.name: Who should get iPhone insurance?

acceptedAnswer.text: iPhone insurance is essential for those who are accident-prone or tend to lose their phones easily. It’s a wise option if you intend to keep your iPhone for more than a year.

mainEntity.name: How much does AppleCare+ cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: This depends on your device. If you have newer devices namely iPhone X or later, the protection plan starts from $10 monthly or $200 yearly. It is lower for older devices.

mainEntity.name: How can I buy AppleCare+ for products I didn’t buy directly from Apple?

acceptedAnswer.text: It’s easy to opt for AppleCare+ anytime up to 60 days after purchasing your iPhone. You can get it online by going to Apple’s Service and Support page. Enter your device’s serial number to be guided through the process of purchasing a plan. You will have to run a diagnostic test on your device to ensure that you’re not trying to buy a plan for a device that’s already damaged.

mainEntity.name: Can I cancel an iPhone insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can usually cancel a plan within a limited period after buying it. For instance, if you cancel Apple Care+ within 30 days of purchasing it, you will get a full refund less any service you received. Call Apple on 1–800-MY-APPLE for more details.

title.rendered: How to buy Kindle books on iPhone and iPad (2026)

content.rendered:
Things to know:

  • Amazon refuses to pay Apple’s fee for purchases made via the iOS apps. So, you can’t buy Kindle books using the Amazon app or Kindle app.
  • To buy books on iPhone, you must access the Kindle store using the Amazon.com website with Safari.

Kindle is one of the most popular book-reading apps. With over a million books, the app is ideal for avid readers. Whether you’re a bookworm or just looking for a new way to spend your time, knowing how to buy Kindle books on iPhone and iPad will allow you to access the world of literature quickly.

Table of Contents
  • How to purchase Kindle books on iPhone or iPad
    • Create a Shortcut to Kindle Store on your Home Screen
  • Access purchased books in Kindle app on iPhone or iPad
  • Remove downloaded books from the Kindle app

How to purchase Kindle books on iPhone or iPad

  1. Launch the Safari app on your iPhone.
  2. Head to Amazon.com → tap Sign In.
  3. Log in with your E-mail and Password.
  4. Search for your desired book in the Search Amazon bar.

  5. Tap the book → choose Kindle.
  6. Tap Buy now with 1-Click or Buy Now and complete your purchase.

Congratulations! You’ve successfully purchased your book.

Create a Shortcut to Kindle Store on your Home Screen

  1. Open the Safari app and navigate to Amazon.com
  2. Select the Menu icon (three lines) and navigate to Kindle.
  3. Go to Kindle Books.
  4. Tap the Share icon from the bottom of the screen.
  5. Choose Add to Home Screen.
  6. Rename the icon.
  7. Tap Add.

Voila! You can now directly buy books on your Amazon.com from the Kindle shortcut.

Access purchased books in Kindle app on iPhone or iPad

Before accessing the books, make sure you have logged in to the Kindle app using the same email ID you made the purchase with.

  1. Open the Kindle app on your iPhone.
  2. Head to the Library view.
  3. Tap the purchased book to download it to the device.

You’ll notice a check mark on the book’s cover, which indicates that you’ve successfully downloaded the book to your device.

Remove downloaded books from the Kindle app

  1. Head to Kindle app → Library view.
  2. Switch to the Downloaded tab.
  3. Press and hold a book.
  4. Choose Remove Download.

You may also choose Permanently Delete. However, this will erase your purchase, and you might need to repurchase it for future reference. I’d suggest avoiding this option.

Happy reading…

I hope this article has helped you buy your favorite Kindle books on iPhone and iPad. Below, don’t forget to take a look at my recommendations that might help you read more!

FAQs

Can I read Kindle books offline on my iPhone?

Yes, you can read Kindle books on your iPhone offline. Once you download a book through the Kindle app, it will be displayed in the Device area. Every book on the Device tab can be browsed offline.

Is Apple Books better than Amazon Kindle?

Both apps allow you to read books and listen to audiobooks of your choosing. However, one significant difference between the two is that the Kindle app has a far more extensive library of eBooks while the Apple Books allows you to read free books.

What are some good alternatives for Kindle?

Kindle is one of the finest applications for reading eBooks, but if you don’t like it, check out our list of the best book apps for your iPhone and iPad.

Read more:

  • Best ebooks reader apps for iPhone
  • How to customize themes while reading books on iPad and iPhone

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, there are a number of ways to insure your iPhone. However, most people prefer buying directly from AppleCare.

mainEntity.name: Who should get iPhone insurance?

acceptedAnswer.text: iPhone insurance is essential for those who are accident-prone or tend to lose their phones easily. It’s a wise option if you intend to keep your iPhone for more than a year.

mainEntity.name: How much does AppleCare+ cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: This depends on your device. If you have newer devices namely iPhone X or later, the protection plan starts from $10 monthly or $200 yearly. It is lower for older devices.

mainEntity.name: How can I buy AppleCare+ for products I didn’t buy directly from Apple?

acceptedAnswer.text: It’s easy to opt for AppleCare+ anytime up to 60 days after purchasing your iPhone. You can get it online by going to Apple’s Service and Support page. Enter your device’s serial number to be guided through the process of purchasing a plan. You will have to run a diagnostic test on your device to ensure that you’re not trying to buy a plan for a device that’s already damaged.

mainEntity.name: Can I cancel an iPhone insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can usually cancel a plan within a limited period after buying it. For instance, if you cancel Apple Care+ within 30 days of purchasing it, you will get a full refund less any service you received. Call Apple on 1–800-MY-APPLE for more details.

blockGraphs.answer: Both apps allow you to read books and listen to audiobooks of your choosing. However, one significant difference between the two is that the Kindle app has a far more extensive library of eBooks while the Apple Books allows you to read free books.

blockGraphs.question: What are some good alternatives for Kindle?
blockGraphs.answer: Kindle is one of the finest applications for reading eBooks, but if you don't like it, check out our list of the best book apps for your iPhone and iPad.

title.rendered: How to limit Photo access on your iPhone or iPad

content.rendered:
Your iPhone’s Photos app holds countless memories, but not every app you use needs full access to your photo library. Fortunately, the iPhone lets you control which apps can view your photos and limit how much of your library they can access. Thus, you can protect your privacy. In this article, I’ll demonstrate how you can limit iPhone Photos app access for third-party apps.

Table of Contents
  • Why should you limit Photos app access?
  • How to limit Photos app access for apps on iPhone or iPad

    Why should you limit Photos app access?

    Limiting access to your Photos app is essential for protecting your privacy and managing your personal data. Here are some key reasons why you should consider restricting photo library access:

    • Protect sensitive images: Your photo library may contain private pictures, screenshots, or documents you don’t want every app to see. Limiting access ensures only trusted apps can view your selected photos.
    • Prevent unnecessary data sharing: Some apps might use your photos for data collection or analysis without your explicit knowledge. Restricting access helps prevent unintentional sharing of personal data.
    • Reduce app permissions: Granting full access to apps you rarely use increases the risk of misuse. By limiting access, you maintain control over your library while still allowing essential functionality.
    • Enhance security: Keeping unnecessary apps away from your photos reduces potential vulnerabilities, especially when using third-party apps. It adds an extra layer of security to your personal information.

    How to limit Photos app access for apps on iPhone or iPad

    1. Launch the Settings app on your iPhone.
    2. Head to Apps and select the app you want to restrict.
    3. Tap Photos.
    4. Select the type of access you want to grant:
      • None: The app will be denied access to the Photos app.
      • Limited Access: The app can only access the photos you select.
      • Allow Full Access: The app will have access to all images in the Photos library.
      • Add Photos Only: Some apps offer this option. When selected, that app can add photos to your library but cannot access photos and videos.

    Note You can manually select albums or individual images and videos that an app can view without granting full photo library access to it. For that, select Limited Access, choose the photos and videos, and tap Done. You may even change the selected photo later from Settings.

    Control app access to your photos when opening it for the first time

    You will see an alert when a new or existing app asks for Photos app permissions for the first time.

    From the prompt about Photos app access, choose one of three options: Limited Access to select specific photos, Allow Full Access for the entire library, or Don’t Allow to deny access completely.

    Full access, partial access, or no access at all?

    Protecting your personal photos is crucial, especially when using third-party apps. Following the steps in this guide, you can ensure your photo library is secure. What are your thoughts on this feature? Please share your opinions in the comments below.

    FAQs

    What does “limited access to photos” mean?

    Limited access allows you to control what apps have access to your Photos library. When you limit access, an app can only see the photos and albums that you specifically choose to share with it.

    What happens if I restrict an app’s access to my Photos?

    When you limit an app’s access to your Photos, the app can no longer view all your photos and albums. It can only access the photos and albums you explicitly choose to share with it.

    What are the advantages of restricting app access to Photos?

    Restricting app access to Photos has several benefits, including enhanced privacy protection, extended battery life, and potential improvement in device performance.

    What are the potential downsides of limiting app access to Photos?

    When limiting app access to Photos, consider a few drawbacks: certain apps may not function properly, you may need to manually share photos with apps, and you may not be able to access all features of some apps.

    Read more:

    • How to use Safety Check on iPhone to stop sharing your information
    • 12 iPhone security and emergency features you should start using

mainEntity.name: What does "limited access to photos" mean?

acceptedAnswer.text: Limited access allows you to control what apps have access to your Photos library. When you limit access, an app can only see the photos and albums that you specifically choose to share with it.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I restrict an app's access to my Photos?

acceptedAnswer.text: When you limit an app's access to your Photos, the app can no longer view all your photos and albums. It can only access the photos and albums you explicitly choose to share with it.

acceptedAnswer.text: Restricting app access to Photos has several benefits, including enhanced privacy protection, extended battery life, and potential improvement in device performance.

title.rendered: Identify laundry tag and car dashboard symbols with your iPhone camera

content.rendered:
Deciphering laundry care labels or unfamiliar car dashboard symbols can feel like solving a riddle. But what if your iPhone could lend a helping hand? With Visual Look Up, you can quickly understand these symbols by simply clicking a photo. In this guide, I’ll show you how to look up the meanings of laundry tag and car dashboard symbols with your iPhone camera.

Table of Contents
  • How to identify laundry care symbols with your iPhone camera
  • How to identify car dashboard symbols with your iPhone camera

How to identify laundry care symbols with your iPhone camera

You may have seen the cloth tags on your garments. It includes instructions for bleaching, ironing, drying, and washing. Some laundry tags include written instructions, such as “Don’t bleach,” or “Dry-clean only,” etc. However, you may come across tags with symbols only.

Understanding such laundry instructions might be challenging as we need to manually search for their meanings. So, to help you out, Apple has created this wonderful feature. Let’s see how this works.

  1. Open the Camera app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap the shutter to capture a photo of a laundry tag with symbols.
  3. Select the square preview window at the bottom to view the photo.


    ‍
  4. Tap the blue washing machine icon (info icon) at the bottom.
    If you don’t see the said icon, retake the photo after zooming in.
  5. Select Look Up Laundry Care to see the detected laundry symbols.
  6. Tap any detected laundry care symbol to understand what it means.

With almost 36 different laundry care symbols, it’s difficult to know what each one means. Thankfully, with Visual Look Up, identifying these symbols is a piece of cake.

Apple provides this information from the International Organization for Standardization. When you tap a detected symbol, you are redirected to their official site.

Note Don’t use any devices while driving. While parked somewhere safe, you may use Visual Look Up to identify auto symbols.

How to identify car dashboard symbols with your iPhone camera

  1. Open the Camera app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap the shutter to capture a photo of your car’s instrument cluster or any buttons or knobs on the center console.
  3. Select the square preview window at the bottom to view the photo.
  4. Tap the blue steering wheel icon (info icon) at the bottom.
    If you don’t see the said icon, retake the photo after zooming in.


    ‍
  5. Then tap Look Up Auto Symbol to see all the detected symbols.
  6. Select any detected auto symbol to understand what it means.

Identifying auto symbols can be quite useful if you want to understand what those bright warning signs on your car’s instrument cluster mean.

Do more with Visual Look Up!

Visual Look Up on iPhone is a great feature that can help you identify objects around you and add context to them. In the comments section below, let us know your thoughts on this new feature.

FAQs

What other things can I identify with Visual Look Up?

Visual Look Up can help you identify objects like books, popular landmarks, and artworks, as well as living things like insects, animals, or plants. Moreover, you can also use Visual Look Up to find recipes from food pics.

Which iPhone models support Visual Look Up?

Visual Look Up is available on iPhone models that support at least iOS 15 and feature Apple’s A12 Bionic or newer chipset. This includes all iPhone models that were released after iPhone X in 2017.

Why is my lookup not working on my iPhone?

From improper configuration to internet-related issues, there are several reasons why Visual Look Up may fail to work for you. If you’re facing such issues, you can take a look at our guide on fixing Visual Look Up on your iPhone

Also read:

  • How to set timer on iPhone camera to take hands-free photos
  • How to use Live Text on iPhone or iPad
  • How to use Google Lens on your iPhone and iPad

title.rendered: How to use Safety Check on iPhone to stop sharing your information

content.rendered:
Our iPhones hold a lot of sensitive and personal information, so protecting that data is crucial. To help you, the Safety Check feature lets you quickly review and manage the access granted to people and apps. You can activate the emergency reset and quickly stop data sharing to prevent data abuse. Let’s learn what Safety Check is and how to use it on your iPhone.

Table of Contents
  • What is Safety Check on iPhone?
    • What is Emergency Reset, and how it works?
  • What does change when you use Safety Check on iPhone
  • How to perform an Emergency Reset using Safety Check on an iPhone
  • How to manage sharing and access on an iPhone's Safety Check
  • Understand the risks of the Safety Check feature

What is Safety Check on iPhone?

Safety Check is a security tool that stops sharing your location in Find My Network, resets your privacy permission for all apps, and protects access to your messages by signing out of your iCloud account.

Many of us are comfortable sharing credentials with our partners. They may know your iPhone passcode or have their Face ID or Touch ID saved on your iPhone so you can access information on your iPhone. Moreover, you may have shared photo albums, passwords, etc.

However, in some abusive relationships, this becomes a threat to privacy and can even prevent us from getting help.

Basically, Safety Check consists of two main features:

  1. Emergency Reset – Quickly resets access to your device’s information for all people and apps.
  2. Manage Sharing and Access – This allows you to customize access you’ve given to apps and people.

What is Emergency Reset, and how it works?

As the name suggests, Emergency Reset is for emergency situations when you don’t want anyone to access your location or iCloud data. This feature wipes all access permissions and redirects you to review your account security and reset your credentials. Moreover, Apple will not notify other users who have access to it.

When you perform an Emergency Reset, Apple will perform actions in these three areas.

  • People And Apps: It will immediately stop sharing your data with everyone and remove access from all apps.
  • Account Security: You will be asked to change the password of your Apple ID and review account security.
  • Emergency Contacts: We can edit existing or add a new emergency contact to the list.

There is another option called Quick Exit. When you open the Safety Check screen, you will see it in the top right corner. Tapping it takes you to your iPhone Home Screen, auto-saving your changes in Safety Check settings.

So, if someone snatches away your iPhone and uses the App Switcher to go to the Settings app, they won’t figure out that you were on the Safety Check screen.

What does change when you use Safety Check on iPhone

As mentioned earlier, Safety Check stops sharing data with people and apps and logs you out of your device. So no one can exploit your data. When you use the feature, the following things occur:

  • Remove devices signed in to your account
  • Update trusted phone numbers and emergency contacts
  • Change your Apple ID password
  • Update your device passcode and your Face ID or Touch ID information
  • Restrict Messages and FaceTime to your iPhone
  • Turn off data sharing on Activity, Check In, Health, and Home app
  • Remove your information from shared calendars, shared items and locations in Find My, shared Maps ETA, shared Notes, shared Passwords, and shared Photos (including Shared Library and Shared Albums).
  • Revoke access to privacy permissions such as Bluetooth, Contacts, Calendars, Location, Microphone, Camera, and more.
  • Deletes all data gathered by Files, local network, Apple Music, Reminders, Research, speech recognition, etc. apps and features.

Therefore, your privacy is safe by all means! As your Find My location sharing is stopped, they can’t even track you down. If you still feel at risk, you can use the Emergency SOS feature on your iPhone.

How to perform an Emergency Reset using Safety Check on an iPhone

  1. Go to the Settings app on your iPhone.
  2. Scroll down and select Privacy & Security.
  3. Select Safety Check → Tap Emergency Reset.

  4. Tap Start Emergency Reset → Reset People & Apps.
  5. Tap Reset.

  6. Select the device you want to remove access from.
  7. Tap Remove Selected Devices → Next.
  8. Now, add or remove the trusted phone number → tap Continue.
  9. Update Apple ID password → Continue.

  10. Add or remove emergency contacts → tap Continue.
  11. Tap Done.

How to manage sharing and access on an iPhone’s Safety Check

You can customize with whom you share your Information, which includes granting/revoking access to apps and people. It will save the changes on the spot. Moreover, it won’t even notify the users about the same. In sharing access management, you can manage People, Apps, and Account security.

  1. Go to the Settings app on your iPhone.
  2. Select Privacy & Security.
  3. Select Safety Check → Manage Sharing and Access → Continue.
  4. Select the people you want to share data with → Continue.

  5. Next, select the apps you want to grant access to → Continue.
  6. Finally, choose the devices you want to revoke access → Remove Selected Devices.
  7. Add or remove Trusted Phone Number → Continue.

  8. Update your Apple ID Password.
  9. Add or remove Emergency contact.
  10. Update your iPhone Passcode.
  11. Now, tap Quick Exit at the top right.

Understand the risks of the Safety Check feature

Nothing is 100% perfect, and it applies to Apple’s Safety Check as well. While Safety Check is excellent in situations such as domestic violence, the feature also has major disadvantages.

For instance, what if the partners use the same Apple ID on their devices, and there’s a rift between them; one partner (say abuser) revokes access of the other partner (the victim) before the latter and gets access to all their data, including the proof. In such a case, the victim will get locked out of their data.

This major flaw can be partially prevented by implementing a simple step like OTP authentication via the registered phone number or email.

Signing off

I hope the above guide helped you understand more about the iPhone’s Safety Check feature and how it works. What do you think about this feature, and how do you think Apple will overcome its misuses? Share your thoughts in the comments below!

FAQs

Does Safety Check stop others from accessing your messages?

Yes, once you have revoked access from the device, no one can access your iCloud account data or even messages and photos.

Do other people know when you use Safety Check?

No, Apple will not notify other users. But they might eventually find that they no longer have access.

title.rendered: Best folio cases for 10.9-inch iPad 10th generation in 2026

content.rendered:
When buying a cover for your new 10.9-inch iPad (10th generation), there are several aspects to consider. One of these is how you intend to utilize it. If multiple viewing angles and complete protection are your top priorities, a folio case is what you need. So, I’ve put together a list of the best folio cases for the 10.9-inch iPad 10th generation to help you get the most out of your device.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Spigen Ultra Hybrid Pro – Editor's choice
  • 2. ESR Rebound – Strong magnets
  • 3. MoKo case – Slim design
  • 4. Supveco case – Fancy design
  • 5. ZtotopCases folio case – Premium leather

1. Spigen Ultra Hybrid Pro – Editor’s choice

The Ultra Hybrid Pro by Spigen is one of the sturdiest folio cases available in the market. Made with the amalgamation of polyurethane, polycarbonate, and thermoplastic polyurethane, the case has high tensile strengths and resistance to oil and water. To absorb shock effectively and protect against drops, the company has used air-cushion technology. 

The foldable cover not only protects your screen but can also be transformed into a stand, allowing you to operate your device for longer periods of time comfortably. The makers have thoughtfully built the case in a way that leaves enough appropriate space for its screen protectors. 

The product might come with a hefty price tag, but we all know that when it comes to Apple device accessories, Spigen is a well-known name, and we can always be confident of the product’s quality.  

Pros

  • Sturdy 
  • Smart design to strap down Apple Pencil
  • Precise cutouts for speakers, Touch ID, and charging

Cons

  • Expensive 

Check out on: Amazon

2. ESR Rebound – Strong magnets

Here’s another case that’s giving others a run for their money. As the name implies, the ESR Rebound Magnetic Case has powerful magnets that strengthen the connection between the iPad and the case. This case is available in a range of colors that feel excellent in hand and offer adequate gripping to prevent frequent slide falls. 

The case also has a cover that provides a silky-smooth premium touch experience. Providing a terrific experience while watching movies, reading online, or designing, the magnetic trifold cover effortlessly converts into a two-way kickstand. It also comes with an auto sleep/wake feature. 

The magnetic case has a streamlined design that does not add bulk, making it extremely portable. ESR is a brand recognized for its high-quality products, so if you choose to buy this one, you know you’re picking a trustworthy company. 

Pros

  • Magnetic case 
  • Sleek design 
  • Lightweight 

Cons

  • No Apple Pencil holder

Check out on: Amazon | ESR

3. MoKo case – Slim design

Looking for a minimal yet high-quality case for your 10th generation iPad? Then this MoKo protective cover is among the best in its class. The back of the case is made with translucent polycarbonate for strength, and the front features soft-lining microfibers with PU leather for comfort. The cover is simple to clean, does not absorb water, and is long-lasting.

Because the case has built-in magnets, it can support an auto wake/sleep feature, which also helps you save battery. Furthermore, the case’s cover is convertible and provides a firm basis for a satisfying reading or writing experience.

The Apple Pencil is the most often used attachment with an iPad; therefore, MoKo designed the cover to make space for Apple Pencil. MoKo’s perfectly carved casing provides simple access to all functions and controls, including speakers, earphones, and volume settings. All of these characteristics are enough to consider this item a great iPad companion.  

Pros

  • Supports Apple Pencil charging 
  • 360° protection
  • Affordable 

Cons

  • A bit slippery 

Check out on: Amazon 

4. Supveco case – Fancy design

Are you a member of the butterfingers club and looking for a robust cover that will protect your iPad from repeated drops? Then this Supveco folio case is exactly what you’re looking for; it has a silicon back that feels pleasant on your touch and a TPU cover that offers full protection from shocks and scratches while also providing durability and a strong grip on the device. 

Another bonus is the built-in pencil holder. The case makes it easy to carry and protect the Apple Pencil while allowing seamless charging and pairing. Thanks to the integrated magnets, this folio case supports the auto sleep/wake feature. 

Furthermore, the company is confident about its product and offers a one-year free replacement assurance, which is one of the major reasons this product made it to my list of the best folio cases for the 10.9-inch iPad 10th generation. 

Pros

  • Economical 
  • Comes with Apple Pencil holder
  • Strong magnetic closure for auto wake/sleep function

Cons

  • No tri-fold design 

Check out on: Amazon 

5. ZtotopCases folio case – Premium leather

If you are seeking a leather folio case, then this ZtotopCases case is the one for you. It features all-around protection and is made of PU leather, which ensures a long-lasting casing. Surprisingly, the case has a wallet where you may keep your cards, cash, and even notes.

The case’s interior is coated with lining fabric that protects your gadget from scratches, shock, and drops. It also includes a built-in hand strap to make one-handed operation easier. Moreover, the device features a specific slot to keep your Apple Pencil secure, but unfortunately, you can’t charge the same while it is attached to the case. 

This product can also be used as a kickstand case for comfortable typing or viewing angles. Further, with the case on, all controls and functionalities of the 10th generation iPad are easily accessible.

Pros

  • Auto wake/sleep
  • Shockproof 
  • Premium built 

Cons

  • Pencil grip isn’t strong

Check out on: Amazon 

That’s all!

It is essential to safeguard your 10.9-inch iPad with a case! These recommended folio cases are one-of-a-kind because they give extensive protection while still providing a hands-free experience that many people overlook. So, which of these cases did you find useful for daily purposes? Please let me know in the comments below.
