title.rendered: Best Bluetooth speakers for iPhone in 2026

content.rendered:
Modern smartphone users utilize their phones for music, movies, podcasts, and even meetings. Although the iPhone’s speakers are decent, you’re better off using external speakers in most aforementioned cases. Fortunately, there’s a great selection of Bluetooth speakers for these purposes.

If you’re on the lookout, I’ve curated this list of the best Bluetooth speakers for iPhone, considering preferences and budgets. Let’s get our groove on and check the entries!

Table of Contents
  • 1. TREBLAB HD77 – Editor's choice
  • 2. Bose SoundLink Flex – Best waterproof speaker
  • 3. OontZ Angle 3 – Best budget speaker
  • 4. Sony SRS-XB13 – For that extra BASS
  • 5. Ultimate Ears MEGABOOM 3 – Best for music playback
  • 6. JBL Charge 5 – Best for house parties
  • 7. Bose Home Speaker 500 – Best premium speaker
  • 8. Infinity Orb Magnetic Levitating Speaker – Unique design
  • 9. Marshall Stanmore II – Excellent equalizer presets
  • 10. JBL Clip 4 – Most compact

1. TREBLAB HD77 – Editor’s choice

  • Connectivity – Wireless
  • Speaker type – Subwoofer, outdoor

The best speakers offer a whole host of features without breaking the bank. With TREBLAB HD77, you get the most modern features without paying an arm or a kidney’s worth.

A super feature of this Bluetooth speaker is that you can pair it with a couple of other stereo speakers for surround sound. While it may not fulfill all the capabilities of surround stereo, you get a sound that’s close to the real thing.

It’s also great for house parties, thanks to its cool ambient lighting features and elegant looks. Moreover, despite its beautiful design, you don’t have to worry about its durability. The speaker is waterproof with IPX6 certification, making it ideal for adventure sports or pool parties, in addition to scenarios such as hiking and trekking due to the shockproof body.

Use the speakers at medium volume, and you can easily eke out a day’s worth of playback in a single charge, thanks to its 5200mAh battery capacity. It also uses the company’s patented PlayXtend energy-saving tech to ensure efficiency. Other features include a built-in microphone to take calls and 33 feet extended Bluetooth pairing. To make it an even sweeter deal, you get a year’s worth of warranty.

The only thing I’d nitpick with is that the annoying “low battery” voice indicator interrupts the music intermittently when using the speaker at low battery levels. It isn’t a dealbreaker but can get very irritating.

Pros

  • Ambient lighting
  • Good build quality
  • IPX6 certification
  • Excellent battery backup
  • 1 year warranty

Cons

  • “Low battery” indicator could’ve been better

Check out on: Amazon | TREBLAB

2. Bose SoundLink Flex – Best waterproof speaker

  • Connectivity – Bluetooth
  • Speaker type – Portable speaker

Bose is one of the biggest names in the audio market. From premium laptop in-built speakers to separate speaker units for concerts, they’re everywhere. You can also be a part of the Bose heritage with the SoundLink Flex.

The design of the speaker is minimalistic with no frills. If you’re looking for a speaker with excellent lighting or flashy looks, this isn’t it. However, if you’re looking for an efficient speaker that does its job well, the SoundLink Flex is excellent.

Moreover, it’s got an IP67 waterproof rating thanks to the materials used in its development. The best part? It floats on the water when you’re using this speaker for your pool parties.

In addition to this, the speaker is quite resistant to drops and dust penetration. The waterproof materials also help it withstand the harmful UV light and the corrosive effects of water.

You know that you’re getting crystal clear and crisp sounds with Bose. This speaker comes with their PositionIQtechnology to provide you with excellent sound quality. It’s also got a microphone, voice assistant connectivity, and a 30 feet Bluetooth range as its miscellaneous features.

My gripe with this speaker, however, is with the buttons on the side of the speakers. They don’t stand out of the frame, so you’ll have to press them fairly hard to get them working.

Pros

  • Minimalist design
  • IP67 waterproof rating
  • Drop and shockproof
  • Superb sound quality

Cons

  • Built-in buttons lack a tactile feel

Check out on: Amazon

3. OontZ Angle 3 – Best budget speaker

  • Connectivity – Wireless
  • Speaker type – Single speaker

When searching for the best Bluetooth speakers for iPhone under $50, you are looking primarily for two things. Firstly, satisfactory sound quality. Secondly, durability. For these two reasons, the OontZ Angle 3 is a good choice.

This sub-$50 Bluetooth portable speaker for iPhone comes with an interesting design choice. It’s in the shape of an elongated triangle. While this will catch your attention at first, it’s a practical design choice to ensure balance on all surfaces.

USA’s Cambridge Sound Works has developed the technology for this speaker, providing you with a guarantee that you won’t be disappointed with the sound quality at this price point. It can also get REALLY loud due to the Volume Booster 10+watt power AMP.

You’ll also be surprised by the speaker’s sheer range of Bluetooth technology. Your phone or laptop remains connected to the speaker even if you’re 100 feet away!

It’s water-resistant, too, with IPX5 certification. So, you can take this budget speaker to all your waterpark adventures. Lastly, the company claims that you can get a music playback time of 14 hours on a single charge.

Unfortunately, the Bluetooth connectivity isn’t too standardized as it has trouble pairing with other devices.

Pros

  • Aggressively priced
  • Tremendously loud maximum volume
  • Bluetooth connects even 100 feet away
  • IPX5 waterproof certification

Cons

  • Bluetooth isn’t compatible with many devices

Check out on: Amazon 

4. Sony SRS-XB13 – For that extra BASS

  • Connectivity – Bluetooth, USB
  • Speaker type – Portable

Sony is one of the most trusted brands globally when it comes to electronics. The Sony SRS-XB13 is another great speaker by the giants of the industry.

The first thing you’ll notice about the speaker is how small it is. Despite its small form factor, it performs quite well. The speaker is waterproof as well with an IP67 certification.

The speaker’s battery life isn’t bad either, with Sony claiming that you can easily get around 16 hours of playback time in a single charge. Of course, they’ve also added a built-in microphone for you to take your calls.

What will surprise you about this speaker is how clear the sound is, especially when playing house music. The bass and treble are mixed well, with the bass particularly effective for specific songs. For a house party with a few people, this speaker is excellent.

Some users have stated that the speaker isn’t too loud. So, if you’re looking for a speaker that projects loud sounds, this may not fit your preference.

Pros

  • Small form factor
  • Decent battery backup
  • IP67 waterproof rating
  • Excellent bass boost

Cons

  • Maximum volume not up to par

Check out on: Amazon | Sony

5. Ultimate Ears MEGABOOM 3 – Best for music playback

  • Connectivity – Wireless
  • Speaker type – Outdoor

If you’re a casual audiophile, you may not have heard of Ultimate Ears. This company has been producing some great products for a more niche market, and now is when you get introduced to the MEGABOOM 3.

For the best music playback, with crystal clear sound quality and perfect equalization, the MEGABOOM 3 has to be one of your top picks. The speaker comes with a 360 degree surround sound capability for the ultimate feel, whether you’re playing chill funk or EDM.

The company has added what they called a “Magic” button that will enable you to play, pause, or skip tracks directly through the speaker. Say goodbye to using your phone all the time for these reasons!

In terms of build quality, the speaker looks tasteful and is covered by a two-tone fabric. This fabric not only adds to the speaker’s looks but also helps in the speaker’s lighting for an ambient feel. The manufacturers have tested the speaker with 25 durability tests to ensure that it’s resistant to drops and shocks.

The MEGABOOM 3 has an exceptional battery life as well, with 20 hours of playback time on a single charge. Moreover, you get an IP67 water resistance rating to take this speaker out to the beach or pool in the summers.

Ultimate Ears have ensured that the speaker is compliant with the Climate Pledge. They’ve constructed the speaker with sustainable materials to help fight the war against climate change. Lastly, it ships with a 2-year limited warranty.

For all these features, you are paying almost a premium, however. The speaker is quite expensive so it may be off-putting to some casual users.

Pros

  • 360 degree surround sound capability
  • The “Magic” button makes playback easier
  • Ambient lighting through the two-tone fabric
  • Highly durable
  • IP67 waterproof rating
  • Climate Pledge compliant
  • 2-year warranty

Cons

  • Expensive for features it provides

Check out on Amazon

6. JBL Charge 5 – Best for house parties

  • Connectivity – Bluetooth
  • Speaker type – Portable

A house party speaker has to not burn a hole in your wallet. The sound quality must be decent, and it shouldn’t be so small that the music is drowned out by people talking. For all these reasons, the JBL Charge 5 is a great option!

JBL has always produced some amazing speakers, and the Charge series is one of the fan favorites. The Charge 5 comes with improvements over its predecessor. It utilizes the JBL Pro Sound technology for better drivers, bass, and separate tweeters. The PartyBoost feature lets you combine this speaker with another compatible speaker for surround sound.

Even when it comes to battery, you’re provided with 20 hours of music playback for the ultimate rager. The speaker is waterproof with an IP67 rating, so spilling water won’t destroy the sound either. Another great feature of the Charge 5 is the built-in power bank. Not only do you get to listen to your favorite music, but you can charge your phone too!

If you’re a music enthusiast, you might find the treble a bit on the higher side. This isn’t too big of an issue, but it is noticeable.

Pros

  • JBL Pro Sound technology provides excellent quality
  • PartyBoost feature combines other compatible speakers
  • Built-in power bank
  • IP67 waterproof rating

Cons

  • Treble is too high for most songs

Check out on: Amazon | JBL

7. Bose Home Speaker 500 – Best premium speaker

  • Connectivity – Bluetooth, Wi-Fi
  • Speaker type – Built-in

A good premium speaker should fulfill the capabilities of a surround stereo speaker without the additional parts. With the Home Speaker 500, you get exactly this.

The design is elegant and can fit into any home decor without a hassle. There’s no doubt about the durability of this product from Bose, especially if you consider the feel of the frame and materials used for its manufacturing.

The sound quality is beyond impressive – it provides a stereo sound from one wall to another without any loss in quality. There’s also a built-in Alexa and Google Assistant that uses a noise-rejecting mic to ensure that your instructions are always clear.

It has multiple connectivity options through Bluetooth, Spotify Connect, and Apple AirPlay 2. There are also 6 presets at the top of the speaker for controlling what plays. If that’s not enough, you can change the music with your voice and the Bose Music app.

The speaker uses Bose SimpleSync technology to pair with other smart Bose, Bluetooth, and SoundTouch devices for a more holistic audio experience. Overall, there’s not much that this speaker can’t do.

The Bose Music app that comes with this speaker isn’t the best, though. The developers need to work more on the app’s performance.

Pros

  • Durable
  • Excellent sound quality
  • Built-in Alexa and Google Assistant
  • Lots of connectivity options
  • Bose SimpleSync technology connects with other compatible speakers and devices

Cons

  • Bose Music App is rudimentary at best

Check out on: Amazon 

8. Infinity Orb Magnetic Levitating Speaker – Unique design

  • Connectivity – Bluetooth
  • Speaker type – 3D

When it comes to the best Bluetooth wireless speakers for iPhone, it doesn’t get any more wireless than an actual magnetic levitating speaker. For those of you looking for something quirky and unique, this is it!

The Infinity Orb Magnetic Levitating Speaker will catch the attention of even the most enthusiast audiophiles. The speaker levitates above the base thanks to very strong magnets.

The speaker almost looks like it comes from the future, with a minimalist, tech-oriented design that you see in movies set in the distant future. In terms of capabilities, the speaker can be used without the base. It connects through Bluetooth 4.0 and has a special sound guide, Cone, perfecting the timbre for a 3D surround sound effect.

There are LED lights on the base as well. This glow is based on ambient music. However, users have reported that the LED lights can be too bright, and the color can’t be changed.

Pros

  • Quirky design
  • 3D surround sound effect
  • Bluetooth 4.0 enabled

Cons

  • LED lighting could’ve been better
  • Too expensive for the features

Check out on Amazon

9. Marshall Stanmore II – Excellent equalizer presets

  • Connectivity– RCA, Bluetooth
  • Speaker type – Subwoofer

While Marshall is known more as a company for producing amplifiers for guitars and other instruments, they’ve also got some excellent products in terms of speakers. The Marshall Stanmore II is one of the best speakers you can buy if you’re someone who likes tinkering with sounds.

The design is classic Marshall – a front mesh with the Marshall logo, framed by sturdy material. This design choice is pervasive in almost all Marshall products and gives a timeless classic vibe.

Stanmore II provides crisp sounds and can connect with any device thanks to the Bluetooth 5.0 aptX technology. This ensures that there’s no latency and loss in sound quality.

The bell of the ball, however, is the sound customization. You can adjust the treble, bass, and timbre of any song with the in-built controls on the top panel of the speaker. You can also download the Marshall Bluetooth app to mess around with the sounds to find something you like.

This speaker can be connected to multiple hosts. In addition, it offers various connectivity options based on your preference.

Unfortunately, just like any other Marshall product, you’ll have to pay a premium for this.

Pros

  • Classic Marshall design
  • Bluetooth 5.0 aptX enabled to reduce latency
  • Insane sound customization
  • Various connectivity options provided

Cons

  • Expensive

Check out on: Amazon | Marshall

10. JBL Clip 4 – Most compact

  • Connectivity – Bluetooth
  • Speaker type – Portable

Small speakers come in all shapes and sizes. The major issues with them, however, tend to be the sound quality and volume. With JBL Clip 4, you get a cute, small speaker that can get loud without compromising sound quality.

JBL has used its patented JBL Pro Sound technology to deliver an intense sound. Even when it comes to the bass, you’d be pleasantly amazed at how punchy it is.

The speaker’s design has been reimagined with a carabiner for better portability and integrity. It’s also waterproof with an IP67 water resistance rating, perfect for your pool parties.

JBL states that Clip 4 can play music at a medium volume for up to 10 hours. This is pretty good for a speaker of this size. However, they haven’t added a battery meter to this device, making it difficult to know when the battery is about to run out.

Pros

  • Small form factor
  • Portable design
  • IP67 water resistance
  • 10-hour battery backup
  • Decent sound quality

Cons

  • No battery indicator

Check out on: Amazon | JBL

Summing up

Bluetooth speakers make our lives much easier. Nonetheless, the sheer range of speakers available online and offline make it difficult to make the right decision for your budget and tastes. Hopefully, with this list of the best Bluetooth speakers for iPhone in 2026, you can decide on a speaker much faster.

Which is the best Bluetooth speaker that you’ve ever used? How was your experience with the speaker? Let me know in the comment section below!

title.rendered: Best iPad car mounts in 2026

content.rendered:
Not-so-surprisingly, there are far fewer options when it comes to an iPad car stand (as compared to iPhone car mounts). Yet, an iPad comes in very handy for GPS, for music and for a variety of other things that you might want to use in-car. When you’re using your iPad in-car, even if it’s just for direction, you’ll need an iPad car mount. While Universal car mounts for tablets can be had for any cheap price, it’s a little harder to find a good-quality accessory. We’ve tried to sift through available options here.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Cellet – Sturdy iPad car mount
  • 2. Macally – 360° rotatable
  • 3. Lamicall – Sleek iPad holder for car
  • 4. APPS2 – 2-in-1 iPad car mount
  • 5. LISEN – The adjustable iPad mount for car

1. Cellet – Sturdy iPad car mount

The Cellet Tablet Car Cradle Holder is a versatile and durable solution for hands-free iPad use while on the road. This holder securely attaches to your car’s cup holders, providing a stable and convenient way to use your device while driving. Whether you’re using your iPad for navigation, entertainment, or even work, this holder will make your experience more enjoyable and comfortable.

One of the standout features of this holder is its adjustable legs and 360-degree rotating design. This allows for a wide range of iPads to be securely held in place, from small ones to large ones. You can easily adjust the holder to fit your device and find the perfect viewing angle for your needs. Additionally, with the release button, you can easily detach your iPad from the secured grip.

The Cellet Tablet Car Cradle Holder is also designed with safety in mind. The soft, padded grips protect your device from scratches and dings, while the holder’s secure attachment to the headrest ensures that your iPad won’t move around while you’re driving.

The holder is easy to install and can be set up in minutes. The mount is adjustable, making it compatible with a wide range of vehicles. This holder is perfect for long road trips, commutes, or even just running errands. Overall, it is a must-have accessory for anyone who uses their tablet frequently while on the road.

Pros

  • Can rotate 360 degrees
  • Robust built
  • Have an inbuilt release button
  • Compatible with trucks

Cons

  • Slightly bulky

Check out on Amazon

2. Macally – 360° rotatable

With this Macally vehicle headrest mount holder, mounting an iPad in a car has never been easier. This adaptable holder can handle a broad range of Apple devices, from iPhones to iPads, keeping your device secure on bumpy roads. The designers ensured a comfortable fit that can be quickly installed without breaking a sweat.

This iPad car seat mount is made of aluminum, which is lightweight and sturdy enough to resist the rigors of regular use. Furthermore, the arms are designed to be flexible to provide a perfect fit even with the bulkiest iPad Pro cases.

The product’s key selling points are the quick-release button and the ball head design that allows for 360-degree rotation. The plastic used in the manufacturing of the extra components is of high quality, and the knobs offered are easy to operate.

With the Macally Car Headrest Mount Holder, you’ll never have to worry about your iPad falling out of reach while driving. The holder’s soft rubber grips keep your device securely in place while also protecting it from scratches and scuffs.

Pros

  • Good built quality
  • Adjustable and expandible arms
  • Ball-head design

Cons

  • Not very stable

Check out on Amazon

3. Lamicall – Sleek iPad holder for car

The Lamicall Car Tablet Holder is a must-have iPad accessory for anyone who frequently is on the road. This iPad holder is made of high-quality aluminum alloy and ABS (Acrylonitrile butadiene styrene) plastic and is meant to last.

The iPad car holder is extremely simple to install and remove, making it ideal for folks who regularly travel in different vehicles. Even though the iPad vehicle mount lacks a release button, it is simple to remove the tablet from the holder by tugging it using the cuffs supplied at the rear of the case.

This is ideal ipad holder for car backseat and iPhone firmly in place as you explore, watch a movie, or just keep your kids amused. This holder, like the others on the list, allows you to spin your iPad 360 degrees.

Furthermore, its sleek and modern appearance will integrate nicely with any automobile interior. The holder also provides easy access to all controls and connections, allowing you to quickly charge your iPad as it is securely held in place. Get your hands on one of the top iPad car mounts and improve the comfort and enjoyment of your vehicle travels.

  • Made of durable materials

  • Unsure about the compatibility with all types of cases

The APPS2Car iPad mount for car dashboard is the best way to keep your iPad firmly in place while driving. This adaptable 2-in-1 mount is intended to fit easily into the CD slot of most automobiles and can handle a broad range of devices, from smartphones to tablets.

This iPad car mount’s innovative design allows you to use the music player while the mount is in place. This means you may continue to listen to music while your device is securely held by the mount.

Unlike other entries on our list of the best iPad car mounts, this one has 360-degree rotary capabilities as well as 240-degree tilt. Another feature I like about the gadget is its broad compatibility and case-friendly design.

The inclusion of anti-slip rubber padding, as well as the 45-day money-back guarantee and 24-month item warranty, makes it a must-have.

  • The knobs are of good quality

The LISEN Tablet iPad Holder for Car Mount Headrest is a handy and useful gadget that securely mounts your tablet or iPad to your car’s headrest. The company has designed this iPad holder using high-quality materials to fit most tablets and iPads, providing a solid and firm grip for your device.

title.rendered: How to use Point and Speak on your iPhone and iPad

content.rendered:
You may already know your iPhone or iPad has a magnifier app to help you zoom into things and see clearly. Now, you can use it to read aloud text and labels thanks to Apple’s Point and Speak feature. It helps people with visual disabilities to navigate and interact with their physical environment. Here’s how to use the Point and Speak feature on iPhone and iPad.

Table of Contents
  • What is Point and Speak on an iPhone?
  • Which devices support Apple Point and Speak in Magnifier?
  • How to enable the Point and Speak feature in the Magnifier app
  • How to use Point and Speak in the Magnifier app on your iPhone
  • Benefits of using Apple Point and Speak feature

What is Point and Speak on an iPhone?

Point and Speak is an accessibility feature built into Magnifier’s Detection Mode. This mode uses the iPhone or iPad’s sensors to detect nearby text, people, doors, and scenes and provide users with sound, speech, or haptic feedback.

Point and Speak combine on-device machine learning and input from the device’s camera and LiDAR scanner to detect and read the text labels aloud when your finger is pointed at them within the camera view.

So, whether you’re navigating appliances or reading labels at a distance, Point and Speak can make daily tasks easier and more independent.

Which devices support Apple Point and Speak in Magnifier?

To use Point and Speak in the Magnifier app, your device needs to satisfy the following conditions:

  • An iPhone or iPad with iOS 17 or iPadOS 17 or later.
  • A device with a LiDAR sensor. LiDAR sensors are currently available on the following iPhone and iPad models:
    • iPhone 16 Pro and 16 Pro Max
    • iPhone 15 Pro and 15 Pro Max
    • iPhone 14 Pro and 14 Pro Max
    • iPhone 13 Pro and 13 Pro Max
    • iPhone 12 Pro and 12 Pro Max
    • iPad Pro (2022)
    • iPad Pro (2021)
    • iPad Pro (2020)

Further, to use Point and Speak in the Magnifier app, you must first enable Detection Mode on Magnifier since its primary controls are for zooming in on things in the environment. Here’s how to do it.

How to enable the Point and Speak feature in the Magnifier app

  1. Open the Magnifier app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap the Settings icon and select Detect.
  3. Here, toggle on Show in Control Panel. Ensure all toggles are enabled.
  4. Then, tap Point & Speak at the bottom and check the settings.
  5. Finally, hit Done.

Once you have ensured all of the above, you can proceed towards using Point and Speak.

Note If you don’t see the Point & Speak option, maybe it’s not available in your region. The feature is only accessible in English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian, German, Chinese, Cantonese, Korean, Japanese, and Ukrainian.

How to use Point and Speak in the Magnifier app on your iPhone

  1. Tap Detect to start the Detection Mode icon.
  2. Press and hold Detect and select Point & Speak (the icon with a pointing finger).
  3. Position your finger under the camera and wait for your device to announce that your finger has been detected. You’ll also see a Hand Detected notification on the screen.

  4. Keep your camera parallel to the surface or object being scanned.
    • By default, Point and Speak will detect text under your finger. To change this, tap Settings → Detect → Point and Speak. Under Location, tap Under or Above.
    • Toggle Automatic Flashlight if you want Magnifier to automatically turn on the flashlight for 10 seconds when the environment is too dark to detect text.

You can also select which feedback you want to get whenever you use Point and Speak. Under Detection Feedback, toggle any of the following:

  • Sound: You’ll hear a clicking sound whenever it detects something
  • Labels: Your device will show the text it was able to recognize
  • Speech: Your device will describe/read the text you’re pointing to
  • Haptics: You’ll feel haptic feedback every time it identifies a text

By default, when you point to a text on your iPhone or iPad, it will be enclosed with a yellow border. However, you can modify the color of this border or remove it entirely if you prefer. Here’s how you can do it: 

  • To remove the border: Toggle the Border option to off.
  • To change the border color: Tap Color. A range of color options will appear, allowing you to choose your preferred border color. You can Tap the Grid, Spectrum, or Sliders tab to explore and select the ideal color that suits your preference.

Benefits of using Apple Point and Speak feature

  • Many individuals with low vision can perceive outlines and distinguish high contrasts, helping them identify buttons and objects with significant contrast.
  • However, due to reduced visual acuity, they often struggle to read labels with small fonts or tight spacing.
  • Point and Speak is incredibly helpful for interpreting printed labels on various objects.
  • It’s also useful for individuals whose eyes tire quickly, reducing the need for straining to read small text.
  • The feature can:
    • Detect and narrate small labels for easier understanding.
    • Display detected text in a larger font, making it more accessible.

Wrapping up…

Vision is a precious gift, enabling us to appreciate our surroundings and engage with the world. Unfortunately, many everyday objects have labels printed in small fonts, and for those experiencing a loss of visual clarity, this can hinder interaction with such objects.  

Thankfully, innovative features like Point and Speak can transform your iPhone or iPad into a revolutionary magnifying tool that doesn’t just enlarge labels but also reads them aloud

Can you think of other ways Point and Speak can benefit its users? Share them below!

Read more:

  • Best accessibility tips for iPhone users
  • How to use the Accessibility Shortcut on iPhone and iPad
  • How iOS 18 Vehicle Motion Cues help prevent motion sickness

title.rendered: Best Apple Pencil Holders in 2026

content.rendered:
If you own an Apple Pencil, it’s essential to have a protective case for it and a holder or stand to place on your desk or workspace. Many holders double up as charging docks that keep your stylus powered up for whenever you need it. Further, they come in elegant designs that look nice in any space and are portable too. So, if you want to give your stylus a stylish home, take your pick from these best Apple Pencil holders.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Belkin Pencil Holder + Case
  • 2. TechMatte Charging Stand & Holder
  • 3. MoKo Charger Dock Apple Pencil Holders
  • 4. Square Jellyfish Stylus Holder
  • 5. Supmega Stand for Apple Pencil 2nd Gen
  • 6. Thankscase Solid Aluminium Apple Pencil Holders
  • 7. MoKo Charging Stand with LED Indicator
  • 8. Ciscle Stylus Case and Holder
  • 9. iziz 2 in 1 Charger Dock and Holder

1. Belkin Pencil Holder + Case

The Belkin Case + Stand offers an all-in-one holder for your Apple Pencil. It’s perfect for storing your stylus, carrying it around, and setting it on your desk. The specially designed compartments keep things safe and organized.

The built-in stand keeps your Apple Pencil popped up and within reach at all times. Moreover, the compact, elegant, and minimalist design blends seamlessly with your workspace decor for a professional look.

Pros

  • Sleek design
  • All-in-one solution
  • Protective cover

Cons

  • Slightly expensive

Check out on Amazon

2. TechMatte Charging Stand & Holder

This stylish charger from TechMatte makes it easy to charge your pencil while keeping it upright on your desk, within easy reach. The charging dock comes with a port to plug your pencil into, eliminating the need for charging adaptors.

Moreover, the stand holds both your Apple pencil and cap. It’s made of solid aluminum that guarantees durability and strength. At the same time, it’s easy to use and looks quite good sitting on your desk.

Pros

  • Convenient plug-in design
  • Durable aluminum
  • Easy-to-use

Cons

  • Slow charging speed

Check out on Amazon

3. MoKo Charger Dock Apple Pencil Holders

Here’s another charging stand for your Apple Pencil (1st gen only) that makes for a great holder when you’re not using your pencil. It is beautifully designed and conveniently charges up your stylus to keep it ready for use anytime.

It’s constructed of premium zinc alloy and silicone for a solid build. But it’s still small enough to hold in your palm or carry in your bag. It also resists slipping and comes in three attractive colors with a built-in USB cable.

Pros 

  • Anti-slip
  • Portable and durable
  • Three color options

Cons

  • Does not support 2nd-gen Apple Pencil

Check out on Amazon

4. Square Jellyfish Stylus Holder

If you’re looking for a simplistic and no-frills holder for your Apple Pencil, you’ll love the minimalist design of this one. It’s made of high-quality plastic and serves as a stylish way to hold your Apple Pencil on your desk at home or work.

Further, it is constructed to last, carefully made by engineers in the USA. It takes up negligible space on your desk and can easily be carried in your bag or even your pocket. There’s a lifetime warranty to ensure customer satisfaction.

Pros

  • Extreme minimalist design
  • Small and portable
  • Lifetime warranty

Cons

  • Might get lost easily due to small size
  • Pricey for what it does

Check out on Amazon

5. Supmega Stand for Apple Pencil 2nd Gen

This holder is primarily for your 2nd-Generation Apple Pencil. It’s not compatible with the 1st Gen pencil. It’s made of sleek aluminum and has a modern magnetic design that is super easy to use.

It is durable and sturdy to last you for years. At the same time, there’s a rubber pad on the stick to protect our Apple Pencil. It comes with a screw and Allen wrench, which means you have to put it together yourself.

Pros

  • Modern magnetic design
  • Durable and sturdy
  • Protective rubber pad

Cons

  • Does not support first-generation Apple Pencil

Check out on Amazon

6. Thankscase Solid Aluminium Apple Pencil Holders

Convenience meets cuteness in this dinky little holder for the first-generation Apple Pencil. It is designed like a flower mushroom and is not compatible with the second-generation Apple Pencil.

Additionally, it works as both a vertical and horizontal stand that keeps your stylus within easy reach. It’s available in three color options with a textured look. Perfect for your desk and to take with you wherever you go.

Pros

  • Minimalist design
  • Functions as a horizontal and vertical stand
  • Three color options

Cons

  • Not compatible with Apple Pencil 2

Check out on Amazon

7. MoKo Charging Stand with LED Indicator

Here’s another offering from MoKo that incorporates a handy LED indicator. The red light is on during charging, and the green light turns on when the device is fully charged, which takes about 1 hour.

It can power up your first-generation Apple Pencil and is equipped with an extra 3.0 USB output to charge another device like an iPad or iPhone. This makes it an ideal addition to your desk or workspace.

Pros

  • LED indicator
  • Charge another device simultaneously
  • Three color options

Cons

  • Not compatible with Apple Pencil 2

Check out on Amazon

8. Ciscle Stylus Case and Holder

Here’s a sleek holder for both Apple Pencil 1 and 2 – it features an enhanced grip design to keep your stylus in place. The integrated stand lets you prop up the Apple Pencil for easy access on your desk.

Further, it features a recessed silicone tip holder that safely holds the device. It’s made with a durable plastic exterior with a lid and a fabric lining for added protection and cushioning.

Pros 

  • Sleek look
  • Fits both Apple Pencil 1 and 2
  • 2-in 1 design

Cons

  • No color options

Check out on Amazon

9. iziz 2 in 1 Charger Dock and Holder

Check out this charger stand that’s suitable for the first-generation Apple Pencil. It holds your stylus at a stable and comfortable angle and comes with a USB charging cable for convenience.

Further, the stand is made by aluminum alloy with tactile silicone on the bottom for anti-slip stability and durability. You can also avail 24 hours customer service in case of any quality issues.

Pros

  • 2-in-1 design
  • Anti-slip
  • Good customer service

Cons

  • Not compatible with Apple Pencil 2
  • A bit pricey

Check out on Amazon

Summing Up

Which Apple Pencil holder has won you over? We want to know your choice in the comments below. Don’t forget to check out other essential iPad Pro accessories too.

You may also like to read these

  • Apple Pencil Not Working? Here’s How to Fix it
  • Apple Pencil Grips
  • How to find a lost Apple Pencil?

title.rendered: Best Parental Control Software for Mac in 2026

content.rendered:
While the Internet is many things right, it is not always age-appropriate or safe for your little ones. Kids these days are becoming increasingly tech-savvy, and just monitoring their screen time is not enough. We need something more comprehensive such as parental control software for Mac. This software could prevent your child from stumbling across or browsing sensitive content. And it is not just about monitoring their online activity; we also need to protect them against Cyberbullying and other such stuff.

Thankfully, these software pieces can lessen the burden and simplify things for parents.

1. Qustodio

Qustodio is honestly the best and highly recommended software. With an increase in devices used by kids, parents cannot supervise each passing second their kids spend on the internet. That is where Qustodio steps in.

This software blocks pornographic and explicit content from your child’s devices, even if they search something in a private browsing mode. It also tracks the time spent on Social Media and Games; and also sets a time limit on their browsing and internet in general. But an essential feature of this software is that it allows location-tracking across all of your child’s devices and also has a panic button that the child can use in alarming situations.

Price: $39.95
Download

2. Kaspersky Safe Kids

Kaspersky has proven its credibility time and again over the years with their cybersecurity software and mobile apps. Its Mac parental control software also comes with excellent credentials. This software doesn’t just protect your kids in the virtual world, but it also takes care of them in the real world.

With GPS tracking, you can set a safe area zone for your kids, and every time they step out of that zone, you get a notification. Not only that, but you will also be notified if your child’s device is running out of battery so you could remind them to plug their devices.

Along with these fantastic features, the software also controls your kid’s internet usage and monitors their activities on the web.

Price: $14.99
Download

3. Norton Family Premier

Award-Winning parental control software for Mac, Norton makes the web much safer for your little ones. It keeps them away from inappropriate websites, content, and online predators. Along with time and web supervision, Nortan also tracks their search, social networks, and videos.

The software sends an email alert to you whenever your child is trying to visit a blocked site or search for blocked content. You will also receive weekly/monthly reports with concise activity tracks during that period.

Price: $49.99
Download

4. Net Nanny Monitoring Software for Mac

Quite like the name suggests, Net Nanny is actually like a virtual nanny to your kids that will monitor your child’s online activities on your behalf. Net Nanny is one of the most trusted parental control software for the Mac and Apple devices. You could link it with all your devices and be assured of your child’s online safety.

It prevents your child from being exposed to inappropriate content in real-time along with search filter and website and app blocker as well. Set a Screen Timer for your kids so that they do not exceed internet usage.

Price: $39.99
Download

5. Bark

Bark monitors a total of over 40 services and apps on various platforms, and gives you automatic alerts on email and text when Bark’s algorithms detect potential risks, like signs of cyberbullying, depression, online predators, adult content, and more. Its algorithms monitor four times more than any other similar app.

The software eliminates parents’ need to scour through their kids’ every post and text or spend hours looking at their kid’s phone or debating with them. You know that it is not possible or feasible to read every text of your kid. So, this is where Bark comes in. It has been created in collaboration with child psychologists, youth advisors, digital media experts, and law enforcement professionals.

Bark ensures that your kids are protected, and the family is secure. Unlimited children, twenty-four-seven monitoring, unlimited activity makes this affordable service worth trying.

Price: $9 per month for the whole family
Download

6. FamiSafe Parental Control Software

This parental control software features all the standard tools for keeping your kids safe, such as setting time limits and blocking inappropriate content. It can also recognize and filter out potentially inappropriate images and text messages.

Further, you can monitor your child’s whereabouts using the GPS and geofencing. Block any apps and games that you don’t want your kid playing and use the Smart Schedule feature to set up different access plans. It’s an excellent choice for managing your child’s screen time and content consumption.

Price: $ 9.99 /month
Download

7. Mobicip – Best for Non-Tech Savvy Parents

A well-recognized and recommended parental control app for Mac. Mobicip protects your young ones from the strange world of the Internet. It also ensures that the child’s private data is not shared just with the guardians and not to any third-party app.

An advanced internet filtering ensures that only age-appropriate content is delivered to the user. Mobicip lends parents access to all the devices in the family. They can set screen time, lock/unlock devices, restrict access to certain apps, games, and social media.

Location Tracker lets them track their child or a lost device any time from anywhere. And thanks to a parent-friendly interface, all this and more can be done.

Price: $49.99 / year for 5 devices
Download

8. PureSight Parental Control Software

When it comes to the Internet, parents need to keep a keen eye on their children. PureSight helps parents do precisely that simply and efficiently. It hosts a wide variety of features such as Internet curfew, cyberbullying protection, supervised file sharing, tamper-resistant, parental portal, etc.

PureSight observes your child’s online activity and sends detailed reports to parents about the same. If a potentially dangerous or suspicious behavior is detected, guardians will receive real-time alerts. User-friendly installation and management settings make things easier for even non-tech-savvy parents.

Price: $5.99/month for 3 multi-device
Download

9. 1Focus: App & Website Blocker

While not a children specific app, this one does a pretty decent job in blocking unwanted apps and websites. Perfect for non-helicopter parents who don’t want to monitor each step, and just protect their kids from certain content.

Moreover, the app is perfect for procrastinators, whether it’s a kid, teen or parent. The application can block websites in Safari, Google Chrome, Opera, and Brave. Notably, you can also choose to block specific parts of the website as well.

Block internet access by blocking all web browsers or schedule multiple blocking sessions in advance.

Price: $1.99/month
Download

Let there be more inspiring content !!

Well, that was the list of all the software pieces that you could use to monitor your kid’s internet usage. Little ones are pretty impressionable, and the right blend of entertaining, educational, and inspiring content is a must for them. Parental control software packages listed above can handle this job with finesse; all you have to do is instruct them. Let me know in the comments below if you have taken your pick of the software yet.

  • The Best Video Editing Software for Mac

title.rendered: Best USB-C card readers for Mac in 2026

content.rendered:
Most modern MacBooks come with a USB-C port for charging and file transfer. So if you want to exchange files between your SD card and your Mac, a card reader with a USB-C cable is what you need. Not a dull, cracky one, though. Your card reader has to facilitate file exchange with lightning speed without friction.

Some basic features you should expect from your card reader include usage security, excellent transfer speed, and zero driver installation. To save you the time and stress of searching, I have compiled a list of the best USB-C card readers for your MacBook.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Apple USB-C to SD Card Reader – Editor's choice
  • 2. Anker 2-in-1 USB 3.0 SD Card Reader – Read two SD cards simultaneously
  • 3. Beikell Dual Connector – Cheap Mac USB-C card reader
  • 4. LENTION USB C hub – Up to 500MB/sec transfer speed
  • 5. Hicober USB-C – 2-year warranty available
  • 6. Cable matters – True to the name
  • 7. Satechi USB-C hub – Multipurpose peripheral

1. Apple USB-C to SD Card Reader – Editor’s choice

The Apple USB-C card reader is a simple, sleek card reader designed solely for the Mac ecosystem. As I expected, it transfers high-resolution photos and videos using the UHS-II speed standard – so the transfer pace is pretty smooth.

The Apple USB-C card reader is pretty decent for most needs. But the only problem is that it only supports UHS-II SD cards. You might need an extra adapter to read TransFlash (TF) and microSD cards. The card reader is a bit pricey, though. But that’s expected since it follows Apple’s pricing style.

Pros

  • Compatible with all Macbooks and iPads
  • Durable and compact

Cons

  • It only supports UHS-II SD cards

Check out on Amazon

2. Anker 2-in-1 USB 3.0 SD Card Reader – Read two SD cards simultaneously

The Anker SD card reader is renowned for its simplicity and compactness. Although it’s not packed with many features, it’s compact in that it doesn’t block the surrounding ports.

It works across multiple devices, from Macs to other type-C-supported devices. Unlike Apple’s USB-C card reader, it has a port for Micro cards and can read cards simultaneously. If all you require is a card reader with no additional features that may cause tardiness, this one is a way to go and relatively affordable.

Pros

  • Has a slot for Micro SD Cards
  • It can read two cards simultaneously

Cons

  • You might not find it attractive if you need extra features in an SD card

Check out on Amazon | Check out on Anker

3. Beikell Dual Connector – Cheap Mac USB-C card reader

The Beikell Dual card reader takes the lead on cheapness. It has type -C and type-A inputs at either end and looks like a flash drive – so it’s handy and easy to slot into your Mac.

However, despite having a micro card and a standard SD card slot, it can only read one at a time—unlike Anker. The Beikell Dual card reader has an excellent transfer speed for files. Besides MacBooks, it is also compatible with Smartphones, as it has an OTG option.

Pros

  • Has a USB-A port for older devices
  • Has an OTG option for smartphones

Cons

  • It can only read one card at a time

Check out on Amazon

4. LENTION USB C hub – Up to 500MB/sec transfer speed

Looking to pair your MacBook with many devices at once? Featuring USB 3.0 and USB 2.0 ports with a 4K HDMI port for facilitating streaming on a TV screen, the LENTION USB C hub is the best USB-C card reader to expand your MacBook’s ports by seven more.

Interestingly, it also features a fast-charging outlet that takes up to 100W voltage, allowing you to charge your PC via the card reader while in use. Hence, unlike many conventional card readers that prevent you from charging via the USB-C port while using the card reader, this one doesn’t since it’s a hub.

Although the LENTION USB C hub features many ports, they do not interfere—if you install the Stable Driver 3.0 that comes with it. However, ensure you plug in the power supply if using all ports simultaneously. Surprisingly, it’s relatively cheap despite its value and fast transfer speed, making it one of the best USB-C hubs for Mac. The only limitation is that it can only read SD cards with a maximum capacity of 256GB.

Pros

  • Charge your Mac while in use
  • Expand your Macbook USB ports
  • Transfer speed is up to 500Mb/sec

Cons

  • Limited to reading 256GB-storage space SD cards

Check out on Amazon

5. Hicober USB-C – 2-year warranty available

The Hicober USB-C card reader is a durable but simple and compact USB-C card reader. It features a USB adapter for USB sticks, micro and standard SD card slots, plus a standard SD card slot. It also allows reading from all ports concurrently — up to 2TB of storage.

The Hicober brand boasts 5000 Megabits per second and 480 MB per second read and write speed, respectively, on its card reader. When I tested, it accepted a 2GB file in about 12 to 15 seconds. So I say its transfer speed is top-notch with a bi-directional transfer functionality.

Overall, it’s a little less pricey for the value. And while there might be occasional hitch when transferring files using multiple ports at once, the company gives a two-year warranty.

Pros

  • Can be used for cards and thumb drives
  • 2-year warranty

Cons

  • Slightly expensive

Check out on Amazon

6. Cable matters – True to the name

The Cable Matters dual slot USB-C card reader is as simple as they come, offering only card-reading functionality, unlike the LENTION hub. It has a slot for only Micro and standard SD cards and can read both inserted cards simultaneously.

The Cable Matters SD card is lightweight (less than 2 ounces), and it has an indicator that flashes when successfully connected to your Mac. It is highly compatible with different versions of Macs, OTG-enabled smartphones, and other USB-C-compatible devices.

Although the read/write speed of cards limits the card’s speed rating, it can read/write up to 5GB/s. The problem with this SD card reader is that it’s less durable than most standard SD cards since its body is mostly ordinary plastic—plus, it only supports USH-I cards and not USH-II.

Pros

  • Lightweight and compact
  • Impressive transfer speed
  • Read two cards simultaneously

Cons

  • Plastic body is fragile

Check out on Amazon

7. Satechi USB-C hub – Multipurpose peripheral

The Satechi USB C hub by the Satechi brand is an excellent choice for a card reader. It features an HDMI port with up to 4K clarity, a USB-C charging port — capable of charging up to 60W, and multiple 3.0 USB-A ports. Its unique feature includes a Gigabit Ethernet port.

It is a durable Aluminum design product, well built, and excellently compact. You can always carry it around with you. Interestingly, the HDMI port does not only allow for mirroring screens but extending screens too. This Satechi brand product comes in different colors, including Silver and Space Grey. It reads/writes USH-II cards but at USH-I limits.

This card reader is highly compatible with different versions of Macs and other devices with Thunderbolt 3 or 4 ports. It goes at a fair price despite its valuable features. The brand has excellent customer support and promises to refund or replace faulty hubs within 30 days of receipt.

Pros

  • Gigabit ethernet is available for connectivity
  • It comes with type-C charging port
  • Impressive customer support and refund policy

Cons

  • Aluminium component can get hot.

Check out on Amazon

Keep reading…

Choosing a durable, fast, and functional USB-C card reader is easy with the right information. I had fun deciding which one to use. And I ended up choosing a card reader that cuts across the board in terms of pricing, speed, and functionality. Feel free to let me know your choice in the comments section below.

  • Thunderbolt vs. USB-C: What’s the difference?
  • Best USB-C to HDMI cables for Mac

title.rendered: Best 10.5-inch iPad Pro Genuine Leather Cases

content.rendered:
The enormously rich profile of genuine leather cases has always fascinated me. I have a particular liking for the ones that have appealing craftsmanship enriched by handmade design. Another essential quality of a high-quality leather case that strikes the right chord with my particular taste is the durability. Besides, they are fully capable of providing a trusted safeguard against shock. Based on excellent quality and top quality, these are the best 10.5-inch iPad Pro cases.

Table of Contents
  • 1. FYY
  • 2. Ztotop
  • 3. icarercase
  • 4. Pack & Smooch
  • 5. KAVAJ London

1. FYY

The FYY leather case is the signature of adorable craftsmanship. With the genuine leather material, it has a luxurious look. The handmade design further enhances its appearance. The hand strap makes it ultra-convenient to carry your device. It would be enormously helpful especially when you are traveling.

There is a pocket wherein you can keep small items like headphones, chargers, etc. It also has a pen holder to ensure your Apple Pencil remains secure. The interior slots allow you to keep your cards and ID safely. You can also stash some dollar bills inside.

The precise cutouts for camera, sensors, and speakers make sure you have a comfortable time while using your device. As for offering the essential protection from drops and scratch is concerned, this leather case can stand up to the mark; without any failing at all.

USP: Rich Craftsmanship
Check out on Amazon

2. Ztotop

Ztotop iPad Pro case is made of real leather to protect your tablet from scratches, shocks, dust and other routine damages. For full protection, Ztotop has used genuine leather exterior and non-slip interior.

Unlike other leather cases, this one boasts 36-degree rotation. Use three built-in slots that enable you to keep your iPad Pro in landscape or portrait viewing angles.

USP: Non-slip interior
Check out on Amazon

3. icarercase

icarercase has redefined simplicity in this genuine leather case for iPad Pro 10.5″. This leather case is made of high-quality cowhide leather, which gives you extremely good feeling and comfort when you hold the case. The case precisely fits on your device and its waterproof soft inner microfiber protects the device from scratch.

The folio style case is exceptionally thin and retains the slim profile of your device. Add to this; there is a magnetic closure without a bulky strap.

USP: Folio style full cover design
Check out on Amazon

4. Pack & Smooch

This sleeve case from Pack & Smooch sports an aesthetic design. It has been crafted with the top quality vegetable tanned leather, and wool felt. The case has an extra pocket wherein you can store things like the charger, earphones, etc.

The magnetic closure allows you to conveniently open and close the case. As it’s very lightweight, you will be able to carry your device with the desired comfort.

About protecting your device from accidental drops and scratch, it should do a fair job. Lastly, this professional-looking case comes in two color combinations such as dark gray and brown as well as gray and light brown.

USP: Aesthetic Design
Check out on Amazon

5. KAVAJ London

If you have a penchant for the genuine leather case, KAVAJ London can win you over with its impeccable design. Carved out of high-quality cowhide leather, it has a classic profile which you would love to flaunt in your office or meeting. The folio case exhibits appreciable workmanship with the smooth finish.

The magnetic closure supports sleep/wake functionality to prevent unnecessary battery usage of your device. There is a big compartment to let you keep some cash or paper.

The high-quality construction can endure impact and offer the necessary shield to your device from shock. Soft flannel inside protects the screen from scratch. You can double it up to have desired viewing angle. Furthermore, there are two color options like black and cognac brown to pick from.

USP: Genuine Cowhide Leather
Check out on Amazon

Your Favorite?

Which one these leather cases have been able to pass your acid test to become an endearing companion of your iPad Pro? Is it a classic looking suit or the one that has a pretty urbane profile? Let us know your favorite pick and the quality you have liked in it.

Rest assured; I will keep on adding more top quality genuine leather cases for iPad Pro in this elite list to ensure you are easily able to find out the right choice. If I have missed to include any quality leather case in this collection, kindly inform me.

You’d like to have a sneak-peak at these accessory lists as well:

  • Best 10.5-inch iPad Pro Folio Cases
  • 10.5-inch iPad Pro Screen Protectors
  • Best 10.5-inch iPad Pro Keyboard Cases

title.rendered: Best monitors for M1 MacBook Pro, Air, and Mac mini (2026)

content.rendered:
The M1 series from Apple has been a huge hit. The devices are incredibly powerful and do good entertainment and functionality. However, the Mac mini does not come with a monitor, and the smaller screens of the M1 MacBook Pro and MacBook Air aren’t the best for gaming, video editing, or other intensive tasks. Hence, a new monitor can be a good investment.

This is why I’ve curated a list of the best external monitors for M1 MacBook Pro, MacBook Air, and Mac mini, according to varied budgets and needs. Let’s take a look!

Table of Contents
  • 1. Apple 32-inch Pro Display XDR – Editor's choice
  • 2. Samsung M5 – Best overall FHD monitor
  • 3. LG 27UN850-W – Best overall 4K monitor
  • 4. Dell UltraSharp U2720Q – Best for power users
  • 5. BenQ PD3220U – Best for editing and gaming
  • 6. Dell S3222HN – Curved FHD monitor
  • 7. BenQ MOBIUZ EX2710S – FHD gaming monitor
  • 8. SAMSUNG J791 – Best looking monitor
  • 9. LG Ultragear 27GN95B-B – Best 4K gaming monitor
  • 10. Lenovo L27M-28 – Best budget monitor

1. Apple 32-inch Pro Display XDR – Editor’s choice

If you’re looking for a monitor to suffice your office and entertainment needs and want to stay within the Apple ecosystem, there’s no better monitor than Apple’s 32-inch Pro Display XDR monitor.

Think about every facet that makes a monitor great. Apple has taken all of these facets and pushed them to their extremes. Apart from the sleek looks of the monitor, it comes with a 6K Retina Display to produce some of the sharpest images that you’ll ever lay eyes on.

Further, instead of the usual High Dynamic Range (HDR) that you get in most monitors, Apple’s monitor provides you with Extreme Dynamic Range (XDR). This provides accurate color reproduction.

The monitor’s brightness is up to 1600 nits, with 1000 nits of sustained brightness. Despite this brightness level, you won’t notice any inaccuracies or problems with the contrast and saturation.

If you add the Pro Stand, you can change the monitor’s height, rotation, and tilt. It not only saves you space but also helps you adjust the viewing angles.

The Pro Stand is overpriced, however. While the monitor itself is good enough, you will have to shell out for the stand if you want to use this monitor in different environments.

Pros

  • 6K Retina Display
  • Best color reproduction
  • 1600 nits of brightness doesn’t disrupt picture quality
  • Build quality is decent

Cons

  • Pro Stand is sold separately

Check out on: Amazon | Apple

2. Samsung M5 – Best overall FHD monitor

While 4K might be all the rage now, FHD monitors still do the trick. Moreover, they don’t cost a fortune. SAMSUNG M5 may be one of the best FHD monitors that you can buy right now.

Apart from the sleek look that would fit in with any Apple-centric setup, it’s also got AirPlay 2 built-in. This means that you can cast your MacBook’s screen directly onto the TV wirelessly. The monitor can also function as an external display.

For your entertainment needs, the Samsung Smart Hub also offers streaming services such as Netflix, Prime Video, and HBO. The 21:9 aspect ratio is a boon for gamers who want a higher field of view for their shooting games. The in-built speakers also do a decent job for most entertainment purposes.

I wish that the manufacturers worked more on the build quality, though. Clearly, they’ve cut corners here to make the monitor affordable.

Pros

  • Sleek looks adjust well with Apple setups
  • AirPlay 2 provided
  • Streaming services provided through Smart Hub
  • 21:9 aspect ratio

Cons

  • Build quality not satisfactory

Amazon | SAMSUNG

3. LG 27UN850-W – Best overall 4K monitor

This LG monitor is the best UHD monitor that you can buy for your M1 MacBook Pro, MacBook mini, or MacBook Air. Here’s why:

The Ultra HD resolution (3840 x 2160) delivers mighty accurate colors, and the viewing angles are great. The build quality of the monitor is satisfactory as well. Moreover, the stand provided with the monitor can be used for adjusting the height and tilt of the monitor to suit your liking,

For gamers, there are advanced settings such as Radeon’s FreeSync, Dynamic Action Sync, and a proper Game Mode. Gamers won’t find any complaints, especially when playing the most demanding racing games or action games.

There are multiple ports for the monitor, including an HDMI port and the USB-C port for connecting your Mac.

The in-built speakers leave a lot to be desired, however. While we can’t expect the best performance from a monitor’s speakers, LG could’ve done better here. You’re much better off connecting to external speakers.

Pros

  • Accurate color reproduction
  • Good viewing angles
  • Great for gaming
  • Multiple ports provided

Cons

  • Low quality speakers

Check out on: Amazon | LG

4. Dell UltraSharp U2720Q – Best for power users

As a 4K monitor, this offering from Dell is a great alternative to other, more expensive 4K monitors. It may not be Thunderbolt-issued, but it’s still got plenty of features.

The USB-C port provided with the monitor can also power delivery up to 90watts. This means that once you plug in your Mac, it not only works as an external monitor but also as a charger.

The monitor also comes with three USB-A ports and an HDMI port for your docking and entertainment needs. The supported refresh rate of 60Hz may not be the best in business, but it’s more than enough for most purposes.

The stand provided with the monitor is satisfactory and can change the monitor’s orientation both horizontally and vertically. The monitor’s bezel and overall build quality aren’t great, though, especially at this price segment.

Pros

  • USB-C port provides 90W power supply
  • 3 USB-A ports and HDMI port
  • Provided monitor stand is satisfactory

Cons

  • Build quality isn’t good for the price
  • Doesn’t have a Thunderbolt port

Check out on Amazon

5. BenQ PD3220U – Best for editing and gaming

The BenQ PD3220U is one of the most underrated 4K monitors in the market right now. If you’re into video editing or gaming, give this one a try.

Not only is the monitor Thunderbolt 3 capable, but it also uses AQCOLOR technology to produce some of the sharpest and most color-accurate images. The screen size is 32-inch, and the bezels are made thin to increase the screen’s area.

Since many spend hours gaming, the monitor also comes with blue light and ZeroFlicker to eliminate screen tearing and the strain on the eyes. You can use this monitor for extended periods without facing any issues.

However, many users have faced firmware issues with this monitor. So you should be wary of this before purchasing.

Pros

  • Thunderbolt 3 capable
  • Plenty of software to remove screen tearing and flickering
  • Thin bezels for greater screen availability

Cons

  • Users have faced a few firmware issues
  • Expensive

Check out on Amazon

6. Dell S3222HN – Curved FHD monitor

4K monitors are turning into the norm, but good FHD monitors can still provide a bang for their buck. This Dell monitor is an elegant offering for those who don’t want to spend exorbitantly on a monitor.

The screen size is 31.5-inch, and the frame is elegantly curved to eliminate distractions. The 3000:1 contrast ratio produces true blacks and accurate colors. Moreover, the screen’s refresh rate of 75Hz is brought by AMD’s FreeSync technology.

Don’t worry about your eye fatigue either – the monitor is stacked with ComfortView technology that eliminates blue light emissions.

The 1920 x 1080 resolution turns slightly grainy with the 75Hz refresh rate. That’s why I’d recommend you to stick to video editing or official works with this monitor. You may not have a satisfying gaming experience on this screen.

Pros

  • Elegant design
  • Color reproduction is superior to competitors
  • 75Hz refresh rate
  • Ideal for office work

Cons

  • The resolution quality decreases at the highest refresh rate

Check out on: Amazon | Dell

7. BenQ MOBIUZ EX2710S – FHD gaming monitor

Gaming monitors with 4K resolutions can be terribly expensive. Thankfully, a good HD gaming monitor won’t cost you an arm and a leg. The BenQ MOBIUZ EX2710S is an option you could check out.

Not only is this monitor powered by AMD’s FreeSync technology, but it also comes with a monstrous 165Hz resolution for crisp and fast display, especially when you’re playing the latest games.

Other technological facets such as BenQ HDRi, Black eQualizer, and Light Tuner combine to provide you with a superior gaming experience. The stand allows you to adjust the height and angle of the monitor as well.

I didn’t like the attached speakers, however. The 2.5 Watt output isn’t good enough for gaming. You will have to use external speakers with this monitor to have a better gaming experience.

Pros

  • High refresh rate at 165Hz
  • Very accurate color reproduction
  • Included monitor stand is sturdy and adjusts well

Cons

  • Poor quality speakers

Check out on: Amazon | BenQ | Best Buy

8. SAMSUNG J791 – Best looking monitor

Curved monitors have become popular over the past few years. The SAMSUNG J791 is a curved monitor that has been making waves recently.

The screen stands large at 34 inches, and the curved display helps increase the immersion for your work. It also supports Thunderbolt 3, and this means that data transfer from your Mac to the monitor will be 4x faster than using a standard USB.

With this monitor, you can open as many tabs as you want without the fear of running out of screen space. Moreover, the QLED screen provides superior color reproduction.

The build quality could’ve been better, though – the monitor’s frame feels slightly cheap and flimsy.

Pros

  • Beautiful design
  • Curved screen
  • Thunderbolt 3 supported
  • QLED screen

Cons

  • Build quality should’ve been better at this price

Check out on: Amazon | SAMSUNG

9. LG Ultragear 27GN95B-B – Best 4K gaming monitor

This monitor from LG is a beast for gaming at 4K. If you’ve got the money to spare, this is definitely worth checking out.

The UHD display provides crisp colors at the highest of resolutions, especially with the latest games in the market. Moreover, the 144Hz refresh rate combines with Nvidia G-Sync and AMD FreeSync technology to eliminate all forms of screen tearing.

The bezels of the monitor are so thin that they’re virtually non-existent. Thus, providing you with the maximum screen estate possible.

It can be slightly difficult to set up, though, especially since you’ll have to enable the 144Hz refresh rate through Nvidia’s G-Sync options.

Pros

  • 144Hz refresh rate
  • Crisp Display and accurate colors
  • Thin bezels

Cons

  • Difficult to set up

Check out on: Amazon | Best Buy

10. Lenovo L27M-28 – Best budget monitor

This Lenovo monitor is up for serious consideration if you’re low on budget. For the price, it’s power-packed with features.

The screen is a 27-inch IPS panel that produces good colors and has excellent viewing angles. The screen isn’t marred with huge bezels either – three sides of the screen have extremely thin bezels for more viewing pleasure.

The monitor has VGA, USB-C, and HDMI ports available. The USB-C port can also be used for charging your devices.

Finally, if you plan to play games with this monitor, you shouldn’t be facing too many issues as it comes with AMD’s FreeSync technology and a 75Hz refresh rate for the optimum gaming experience.

The size of the monitor is pretty big, however. If you plan to use another monitor in the future for a dual setup, this monitor may not be for you.

Pros

  • Superb viewing angles
  • Thin bezels
  • Multiple ports provided
  • USB-C port can charge devices
  • 75Hz refresh rate

Cons

  • Bulky frame
  • Not ideal for dual monitor setups

Check out on: Amazon | Lenovo

Summing up

We like the idea of bigger screens for both entertainment and workspaces now. Whether you’re a gaming enthusiast or work on multiple tabs, I’ve tried to cover all bases in this list of the best monitors for M1 MacBook Pro, Mac Mini, and MacBook Air.

Do you use any FHD, 4K, or 6K monitors for your work or entertainment? How has your experience been using external monitors for your Mac? Let me know in the comment section below.
